articles.title: Experience and impacts of violence and abuse by patients and the public towards general practice staff: a qualitative study
articles.authors: Chou S, Tyrrell E, Rowe E, Bryant J

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: General practice (family medicine) experiences more violence and abuse by patients and the public than in general hospital settings. Qualitative accounts on how violence and abuse are experienced and perceived remain limited in both breadth and depth.
abstract.textZh: 與一般醫院環境相比，一般診所（家庭醫學）遭受患者和公眾的暴力和虐待更多。關於暴力和虐待的經歷和感知的定性敘述在廣度和深度上仍然有限。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To explore direct and indirect experiences of violence and abuse that general practice staff have encountered from patients and the public, and the perceived impact on staff wellbeing and their practice.
abstract.textZh: 探索一般診所工作人員從患者和公眾身上遇到的直接和間接的暴力和虐待經驗，以及對員工福祉及其實踐的感知影響。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: This qualitative study was the second part of a mixed-methods project, following an online nationwide survey of England. Participants were invited to an interview at the end of the survey.
abstract.textZh: 這項定性研究是在英格蘭線上全國調查之後，混合方法項目的第二部分。調查結束時邀請參與者參加面試。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Data were collected via semi-structured interviews conducted between August and December 2023. Quantitative survey responses were extracted to describe the characteristics of participants, their experience of violence and abuse, and feelings of safety and support at work. Interviews were transcribed and thematically analysed following the framework approach.
abstract.textZh: 數據是通過2023年8月至12月期間進行的半結構化訪談收集的。提取定量調查回覆，以描述參與者的特徵、他們遭受暴力和虐待的經歷，以及工作中的安全感和支持感。採用框架方法對訪談進行抄錄和主題分析。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Twenty-three general practice staff members participated, including 17 women and six men. Fifteen participants were in non-clinical roles and eight were clinicians. Six themes were identified: violence and abuse through direct interactions, violence and abuse beyond direct interactions, increased risk, individual impacts, occupational impacts, and impacts on care and services.
abstract.textZh: 23名全科醫師參與，包括17名女性和6名男性。15名參與者擔任非臨牀職務， 8名為臨牀醫生。確定了六個主題：通過直接互動的暴力和虐待、超越直接互動的暴力和虐待、風險增加、個人影響、職業影響以及對護理和服務的影響。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Violence and abuse by patients and the public include a wide range of behaviours. It has profound and, in some instances, longstanding impacts on staff, including a persistent sense of being unsafe and disruption to their personal or social lives. It also affects clinical services through staff turnover and reduced service capacity.
abstract.textZh: 患者和公眾的暴力和虐待行為涵蓋範圍廣泛。這些行為對工作人員造成深遠且在某些情況下是長期的影響，包括持續的不安全感以及個人或社交生活的紊亂。此外，它還會透過人員流動和服務能力的下降影響臨床服務。

articles.titleZh: 患者和公眾對一般醫療人員的暴力和虐待的經驗和影響：定性研究

articles.title: Unpacking barriers to and facilitators for research leadership for Black primary care researchers: a qualitative study
articles.authors: Bajwa RK, Bains M, Mallen CD, Kai J, Agyemang-Benneh AF, Akyea RK

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Individuals of Black heritage comprise 6.2% of the general practice workforce in the UK. Representation is even lower in primary care research. The understanding of why this misrepresentation exists is limited.
abstract.textZh: 黑人血統的個人佔英國一般執業勞動力的6.2 ％。初級保健研究中的代表性更低。對這種虛假陳述存在的原因的理解有限。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To explore representation of researchers of Black heritage at various career stages within primary care, alongside factors influencing retention and career advancement.
abstract.textZh: 探索黑人傳統研究人員在初級保健各個職業階段的代表性，以及影響保留和職業發展的因素。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Qualitative study with 18 researchers of Black heritage and seven primary care senior academic leaders (current or former heads of primary care departments in UK universities).
abstract.textZh: 對18名黑人傳統研究人員和7名初級保健高級學術領袖（英國大學現任或前任初級保健部門負責人）進行定性研究。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Online, one-to-one, semi-structured interviews. Interviews were digitally audio-recorded, transcribed, and analysed using thematic analysis.
abstract.textZh: 線上、一對一、半結構化面試。採訪使用主題分析進行數位錄音、轉錄和分析。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Participants recognised significant underrepresentation of researchers of Black heritage in primary care research. Key barriers to career progression and retention included systemic and structural inequities, racism, and exclusionary academic culture. Facilitators included proactive leadership, tailored training and support for researchers (including international scholars), mentorship, sponsorship, and safe networking spaces. Participants offered recommendations to improve representation and career progression: training for leaders to recognise bias, discrimination, and inequity; leadership development opportunities; tailored career support for researchers of Black heritage; and targeted assistance for international researchers navigating UK academic systems. Visibility of Black role models in academic primary care was seen as essential to attracting and inspiring future researchers.
abstract.textZh: 參與者認識到黑人傳統研究人員在初級保健研究中的代表性顯著不足。職業發展和保留的主要障礙包括系統性和結構性的不平等、種族主義和排斥性的學術文化。培訓人員包括主動領導、為研究人員（包括國際學者）量身打造的培訓和支持、指導、贊助和安全的網絡空間。參與者提供了改善代表性和職業發展的建議：培訓領導者認識偏見、歧視和不公平；領導力發展機會；為黑人遺產研究人員提供量身定制的職業支持；以及為英國學術體系中的國際研究人員提供有針對性的協助。在學術初級護理中，黑人榜樣的能見度被視為吸引和激勵未來研究人員的必要條件。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: These findings highlight key areas for change to foster a more inclusive and equitable research environment in primary care.
abstract.textZh: 這些研究結果強調了需要改變的關鍵領域，以促進初級保健領域更具包容性和公平性的研究環境。

articles.titleZh: 揭開黑人初級保健研究人員領導研究的障礙和促進因素：定性研究

articles.title: Patient, pharmacist, and GP perspectives on identifying and managing polypharmacy: a qualitative study
articles.authors: Tsang JY, Blakeman T, Sperrin M, Kallis TJ, Payne RA, Ashcroft DM

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Polypharmacy is a global priority owing to potential harms, including adverse drug events, hospitalisations, and high treatment burden. Overall, these outcomes have shown little improvement despite numerous interventions, indicating that current approaches to identify and manage polypharmacy remain insufficient.
abstract.textZh: 由於潛在的危害，包括藥物不良事件、住院治療和高治療負擔，複方藥劑是全球優先事項。總體而言，儘管採取了許多幹預措施，但這些結果幾乎沒有改善，這表明目前識別和管理多種藥物的方法仍然不足。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To understand how polypharmacy is identified and managed in everyday primary care from patient, pharmacist, and GP perspectives.
abstract.textZh: 從患者、藥劑師和全科醫生的角度了解如何在日常初級護理中識別和管理多種藥物。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Qualitative semi-structured interviews were conducted with 12 patients and 12 professionals (seven clinical pharmacists and five GPs) across Greater Manchester, UK.
abstract.textZh: 對英國大曼徹斯特地區的12名患者和12名專業人員（ 7名臨牀藥劑師和5名全科醫生）進行了定性半結構化訪談。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Reflexive thematic analysis was undertaken, which was supported by normalisation process theory and constant comparison as sensitisation tools.
abstract.textZh: 進行了反射性主題分析，這得到了歸一化過程理論和作為敏化工具的不斷比較的支持。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Polypharmacy was widely seen as important work but, in practice, inconsistent case-finding and unclear purposes for polypharmacy medication reviews were reported. Patients viewed medications as essential tools to sustain biopsychosocial elements of life, contrasting with practitioners' clinical priorities to mitigate potential harm. Polypharmacy work routinely contained layers of hidden complexity, which was often overwhelming and placed a heavy emotional burden on patients and professionals. Both patients and professionals required training and experience to effectively manage these complexities. Although a protocol-driven approach was sufficient for simple medication issues, only a longer-term approach, predicated on trust, continuity, relationships, and open discussions encouraging healthy conflict, appeared to engage with deeper complexities.
abstract.textZh: 多種藥物被廣泛認為是重要的工作，但在實踐中，報告了多種藥物藥物審查的不一致的案例發現和不明確的目的。患者將藥物視為維持生命中生物心理社會要素的重要工具，與從業人員減輕潛在危害的臨牀優先事項形成對比。複方藥房工作通常包含多層隱藏的複雜性，這通常是壓倒性的，並給患者和專業人員帶來沉重的情感負擔。患者和專業人員都需要培訓和經驗來有效地管理這些複雜性。雖然協議驅動的方法足以處理簡單的藥物問題，但只有基於信任、連續性、關係和鼓勵健康衝突的公開討論的長期方法，似乎會涉及更深層次的複雜性。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Polypharmacy work is fraught with complexity and uncertainty, lacking standardised case-finding and clear purpose for both patients and professionals. Better models of care are needed to meet this challenge, encouraging a shift beyond a biomedically dominated protocol-driven approach to a more longitudinal and relational approach.
abstract.textZh: 複方藥房工作充滿了複雜性和不確定性，缺乏標準化的個案調查和對患者和專業人員的明確目的。需要更好的護理模式來應對這一挑戰，鼓勵從生物醫學主導的協議驅動方法轉向更縱向和關聯的方法。

articles.titleZh: 患者、藥劑師和全科醫生對識別和管理多種藥物的觀點：一項定性研究

articles.title: Moving on from patient safety incidents: a qualitative study exploring GP perspectives in England
articles.authors: Tawse J, Armitage CJ, Chew-Graham CA, Panagioti M

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Patient safety incidents (PSIs), defined as unintended or unexpected events that could have or did lead to patient harm, can have profound effects on GPs. Understanding how GPs experience and recover from PSIs is important for workforce wellbeing and patient safety in primary care.
abstract.textZh: 病人安全事件（PSI）是指可能或已經導致病人傷害的非預期或意外事件，會對全科醫生產生深遠影響。了解全科醫生如何經歷和應對病人安全事件，對於基層醫療從業人員的福祉和病人安全至關重要。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To explore how GPs experience PSIs, how they move on, and how they use available support.
abstract.textZh: 探索全科醫生如何體驗PSI、他們如何繼續前進，以及他們如何使用可用的支援。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Qualitative study with GPs in England.
abstract.textZh: 在英國與全科醫生進行定性研究。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Semi-structured interviews were conducted with 22 GPs. Data were analysed using thematic analysis. Participants were eligible if they had been involved in a PSI in general practice, spanning near misses to events resulting in patient harm. Themes were developed inductively and mapped onto the theoretical domains framework to identify cognitive, social, and environmental influences on learning, help seeking, and recovery.
abstract.textZh: 與22位全科醫生進行了半結構化訪談。使用主題分析對數據進行分析。如果參與者在一般實踐中參與了PSI ，從幾乎錯過到導致患者受傷的事件，則符合資格。主題是歸納開發的，並映射到理論領域框架上，以識別認知、社會和環境對學習、尋求幫助和恢復的影響。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Three themes were generated: personal and professional consequences; recovery and learning processes; and barriers to healing. GPs described emotional responses, including guilt, self-doubt, and fear of reputational or regulatory consequences. Peer support was valued, but access to structured support was limited. Formal investigations were experienced as distressing and compounded the emotional impact. Recovery and learning were facilitated by empathetic, systems-focused cultures, protected time for reflection, and structured opportunities to learn from incidents.
abstract.textZh: 產生了三個主題：個人和專業後果；恢復和學習過程；以及治療的障礙。全科醫生描述了情緒反應，包括內疚、自我懷疑以及對聲譽或監管後果的恐懼。同儕支持受到重視，但獲得結構化支持的機會有限。正式調查被認為是痛苦的，並加劇了情緒上的影響。同理心、以系統為中心的文化、受保護的反思時間，以及從事件中學習的結構化機會，都有助於恢復和學習。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: GPs rely on informal and self-directed strategies to recover from PSIs, with variable access to formal support. Recovery is shaped by individual and organisational factors. Findings highlight the importance of compassionate, non-punitive support systems and psychologically safe environments to enable recovery and promote learning.
abstract.textZh: 全科醫師主要依賴非正式和自主策略來應對職業安全與健康問題，獲得正式支持的機會不一。復原過程受個人和組織因素的影響。研究結果強調了富有同情心、非懲罰性的支持體系和心理安全的環境對於促進復原和學習的重要性。

articles.titleZh: 從病人安全事件的角度出發：一項探索英格蘭全科醫生觀點的質性研究

articles.title: Fighting to be heard: a thematic analysis of parent perspectives on safety in UK general practice
articles.authors: Purchase T, Quinn-Scoggins HD, McFadzean IJ, Donovan L, Hope I, Clarke E, Lifford KJ, Hodson N, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Children are particularly vulnerable to healthcare-associated harm. Parents play a vital but under-recognised protective role in paediatric patient safety. Parent perceptions of and contributions to safety improvement efforts within hospital settings are well documented, but little is known about parent experiences and perspectives in primary care.
abstract.textZh: 兒童特別容易受到與醫療保健相關的傷害。父母在兒科患者安全方面起著至關重要但未被認可的保護作用。家長對醫院環境中安全改善工作的看法和貢獻有據可查，但對家長在初級保健方面的經驗和觀點知之甚少。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To explore diverse parental perspectives on paediatric safety in primary care and identify target areas for improvement.
abstract.textZh: 探索父母對初級護理中兒科安全的不同觀點，並確定需要改善的目標領域。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: This qualitative study in UK primary care was conducted through online (n = 2) and in-person (n = 2) workshops with parents, taking place between 24 June and 8 July 2024.
abstract.textZh: 這項在英國初級保健的定性研究是透過2024年6月24日至7月8日期間與家長進行的線上（ n = 2 ）和面對面（ n = 2 ）研討會進行的。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Workshops were structured around a descriptive analysis of paediatric patient safety incident reports in general practice. Parents discussed and reflected on their own experiences in relation to the findings. Transcripts and field notes were analysed thematically to identify key themes.
abstract.textZh: 研討會是圍繞一般實踐中兒科患者安全事件報告的描述性分析而組織的。父母討論並反思他們自己與調查結果相關的經驗。對成績單和現場筆記進行了主題分析，以確定關鍵主題。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Parents (n = 33) from varied backgrounds, including under-served communities, participated. Three major themes were identified: responsibility of care, highlighting perceived unclear roles between parents and healthcare teams; navigating the system, where parents described the need to 'fight' for care and the challenges of understanding healthcare processes; and communication and language, emphasising the difficulties of being heard, especially among ethnic minority parents and those lacking the confidence to speak up.
abstract.textZh: 來自不同背景（包括服務不足的社區）的父母（ n = 33 ）參與。確定了三個主要主題：護理責任，強調父母和醫療團隊之間感知不清晰的角色；在系統中導航，父母描述了為護理而「鬥爭」的必要性以及理解醫療保健過程的挑戰；以及溝通和語言，強調被傾聽的困難，特別是在少數族裔父母和缺乏信心說話的人中。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Parent perspectives on paediatric safety in primary care have highlighted key areas for practices, researchers, and safety improvement teams to target system change and intervention development. Engaging parents as co-designers in these efforts could enhance trust, reduce risk, and improve safety outcomes for paediatric patients.
abstract.textZh: 家長對初級護理兒科安全的觀點突出了實踐、研究人員和安全改進團隊的關鍵領域，以針對系統變革和幹預發展。讓父母作為共同設計者參與這些工作可以增強信任，降低風險，並改善兒科患者的安全結果。

articles.titleZh: 爭取被聽取：英國一般實踐中家長對安全的觀點的主題分析

articles.title: Online triage and cancer diagnostic activity in general practice: a cross-sectional study
articles.authors: Paule A, Atherton H, Parsons J, Hiller L, Abel G

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Patient-facing online triage tools potentially offer GPs a way to recognise cancer-related symptoms and features to facilitate appropriate suspected cancer referrals. Little is known about their impact on cancer diagnostic process and outcomes.
abstract.textZh: 患者導向的線上分流工具可能為全科醫生提供一種識別癌症相關症狀和特徵的方法，從而促進對疑似癌症患者進行適當的轉診。然而，人們對這些工具對癌症診斷過程和結果的影響知之甚少。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To describe patterns of cancer outcome and process indicators associated with the use of online triage tools in primary care.
abstract.textZh: 描述與在初級護理中使用線上分流工具相關的癌症結局和過程指標的模式。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: This cross-sectional study examined the association between publicly reported practice-level data on 3053 English general practices. An online triage tool was used that linked to practice-level data and 31 233 594 triage forms completed using an online triage tool in 2022-2023.
abstract.textZh: 這項橫斷面研究檢查了3053英國一般實踐的公開報告實踐級數據之間的關聯。使用了一個線上分流工具，該工具連結到2022-2023年期間使用線上分流工具完成的執業級別數據和31 233 594份分流表格。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: A cross-sectional analysis (mixed-effects regression) was conducted to evaluate the association between the annual rate of eConsult forms received (weighted to practice registrations) and various cancer diagnosis process and outcome measures.
abstract.textZh: 進行橫斷面分析（混合效應回歸） ，以評估每年收到的eConsult表格比率（加權至執業註冊）與各種癌症診斷過程和結果測量之間的關聯。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Increased use of online triage forms was associated with higher rates of urgent suspected cancer (USC) referrals and investigations; for example, there was a 7.75% difference in colonoscopy rate (95% confidence interval [CI] = 3.83% to 8.98%) across the 90% mid-range of practices. Despite this, there was no evidence of an association with USC referrals resulting in diagnosis or emergency presentations.
abstract.textZh: 線上分流表格使用的增加與更高的緊急疑似癌症（ USC ）轉診和調查率有關；例如，在90%的中端實踐中，結腸鏡檢查率（ 95%置信區間[CI] = 3.83%至8.98% ）存在7.75%的差異。儘管如此，沒有證據顯示與南加州大學的轉介有關，導致診斷或緊急情況發生。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Greater use of online triage forms is associated with more investigations and referrals for suspected cancer, but not associated with better diagnostic outcomes. This may indicate that any additional referrals are of lower quality and overall there is an increase in inappropriate use of USC referrals. Research is needed to understand how this impacts investigations and referrals for individual patients.
abstract.textZh: 更多地使用線上分流表與更多懷疑癌症的調查和轉診相關，但與更好的診斷結果無關。這可能表示任何額外推薦的品質較低，整體而言，不當使用南加州大學推薦的情況有所增加。需要進行研究，以了解這對個別患者的調查和轉診有何影響。

articles.titleZh: 全科醫療中的線上分診和癌症診斷活動：一項橫斷面研究

articles.title: Primary care cardiovascular risk reduction after pregnancy complications: a qualitative systematic review
articles.authors: Hodges VJ, Shareef S, Chew-Graham CA, Wu P, Adetola M, Mitchell CA

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Adverse pregnancy outcomes (APOs) affect approximately 30% of pregnancies and confer lifelong elevated cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk. Behavioural interventions may mitigate this risk.
abstract.textZh: 不良妊娠結果（ APO ）影響大約30 ％的妊娠，並導致終身心血管疾病（ CVD ）風險升高。行為幹預可以降低這種風險。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To systematically review qualitative literature on women's experiences of behavioural change for cardiovascular risk reduction following APOs, with a focus on health equity.
abstract.textZh: 系統地審查有關女性在APO後降低心血管風險的行為改變經驗的定性文獻，重點是健康公平。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Qualitative systematic review, limited to high-income countries with universal access to health care.
abstract.textZh: 定性系統審查，僅限於普及醫療保健的高收入國家。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: A systematic search of PubMed, Embase, and CINAHL from inception to March 2025 identified primary studies. Thematic synthesis followed Thomas and Harden's three-stage approach. Themes were mapped onto the COM-B (Capability, Opportunity, Motivation-Behaviour) framework to theoretically ground and structure analysis.
abstract.textZh: 從成立到2025年3月，對PubMed、Embase和CINAHL的系統搜索確定了主要研究。主題綜合遵循託馬斯和哈登的三階段方法。將主題映射到COM-B （能力、機會、動機-行為）框架上，以進行理論上的基礎和結構分析。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Eighteen studies involving 339 women met inclusion criteria. Women who were minority ethnic formed the majority in only two studies. Demographic data regarding socioeconomic status, ethnicity, or both were absent from five. Experiences shaping behaviour change aligned with COM-B domains. Delayed physical and psychological recovery after APOs reduced women's capability to initiate changes. Competing demands, including childcare, household responsibilities, and work, restricted opportunity to focus on long-term cardiovascular health. Opportunities improved when behaviour changes were easily integrated into family life and offered shared benefits. Motivation was strengthened by awareness of increased CVD risk, the responsibilities of parenthood, and personalised advice from healthcare professionals. Tailored, proactive follow-up supported engagement, especially for minority ethnic and socioeconomically disadvantaged groups.
abstract.textZh: 涉及339名女性的18項研究符合納入標準。只有兩項研究中，少數族裔婦女佔多數。五人中缺少有關社會經濟狀況、種族或兩者的人口統計數據。根據COM-B網域改變行為的體驗。APO後身體和心理恢復延遲，降低了女性發起變革的能力。相互競爭的需求，包括育兒、家庭責任和工作，限制了專注於長期心血管健康的機會。當行為改變很容易融入家庭生活並提供共享利益時，機會就會改善。對心血管疾病風險增加的意識、父母的責任以及醫療保健專業人員的個性化建議加強了動機。量身定制，積極跟進支持參與，特別是針對少數族裔和社會經濟弱勢羣體。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Prevention of CVD after APOs requires structured, system-level support to prioritise family-based behaviour change. High-risk groups are underrepresented in research; coproducing interventions with these groups may help to avoid widening health inequalities.
abstract.textZh: 預防APO之後的CVD需要結構化的系統級支持，以優先考慮基於家庭的行為改變。高風險羣體在研究中的代表性不足；與這些羣體共同採取幹預措施可能有助於避免擴大健康不平等。

articles.titleZh: 初級保健降低懷孕併發症後的心血管風險：定性系統綜述

articles.title: Co-generating ideas for safer paediatric care with parents and stakeholders: a multi-method UK general practice study
articles.authors: Purchase T, Quinn-Scoggins H, McFadzean IJ, Donovan L, Hope I, Clarke E, Lifford KJ, John I, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Parents play a vital role in protecting their children from healthcare-associated harms, for example, through mitigating safety incidents in general practice. Despite international calls encouraging family involvement in patient safety initiatives, parental perspectives are rarely embedded in the co-design of safety improvements.
abstract.textZh: 父母在保護子女免受醫療保健相關傷害方面發揮著至關重要的作用，例如通過減輕一般實踐中的安全事故。儘管國際上呼籲鼓勵家庭參與患者安全計劃，但父母的觀點很少被嵌入到安全改進的共同設計中。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To co-generate and prioritise ideas for improving paediatric safety in general practice with parents and key stakeholders, and to explore areas of agreement and disagreement between these groups.
abstract.textZh: 與家長和主要利益相關者共同產生並優先考慮在一般實踐中改善兒科安全的想法，並探索這些羣體之間的協議和分歧領域。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A multi-method study combined qualitative methodology with quality improvement tools involving four parent workshops (between June and July 2024) and one stakeholder workshop (November 2024). Parent participants had experience of accessing general practice services with their children; and stakeholder participants included clinicians, managers, policymakers, primary care leaders and patient advocates.
abstract.textZh: 一項多方法研究結合了定性方法和質量改善工具，涉及四個家長研討會（ 2024年6月至7月）和一個利益相關者研討會（ 2024年11月）。家長參與者有與子女一起獲得一般實踐服務的經驗；利益相關者參與者包括臨牀醫生、經理、政策制定者、初級保健領導者和患者倡導者。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Parent participants reviewed national-level safety incident data and used nominal group technique to generate ideas for change. Ideas were collated, refined and presented to key stakeholder participants, who assessed the potential 'doability' (can be acheived or performed) and impact of each idea.
abstract.textZh: 家長參與者審查了國家級的安全事故數據，並使用名義上的小組技巧來產生變革的想法。對想法進行了整理、完善，並提交給主要利益相關者參與者，他們評估了每個想法的潛在「可行性」（可以實現或執行）和影響。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Parents (n = 33) generated 16 ideas for change targeting communication, access to care records and results, and shared learning and development. Stakeholders (n = 7) prioritised seven ideas, including a campaign to support parents to speak up, having flexible appointments for children and designating a parent advocate. Parents and stakeholders most strongly agreed on the need to proactively seek parent feedback and solutions.
abstract.textZh: 家長（ n = 33 ）針對溝通、獲取護理記錄和結果以及分享學習和發展的變革提出了16個想法。利益相關者（ n = 7 ）優先考慮七個想法，包括支持家長發聲的活動，為兒童進行靈活的預約以及指定家長倡導者。家長和利益相關者最強烈地同意需要主動尋求家長的反饋和解決方案。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Parents are willing and able to support healthcare teams with their patient safety efforts. Their ideas align with national priorities and offer actionable strategies that general practice teams can adopt or adapt for safer paediatric care in their own populations.
abstract.textZh: 家長願意並能夠支持醫療團隊的患者安全工作。他們的想法符合國家優先事項，並提供可行策略，讓全科醫療團隊可以採用或適應更安全的兒科護理。

articles.titleZh: 與父母和利益相關者共同創造更安全的兒科護理理念：一項多方法的英國一般實踐研究

articles.title: 'One of the hardest things in medicine is challenging an initial diagnosis': interim diagnoses and missed opportunities for diagnosing cancer in primary care, a qualitative study
articles.authors: Robles LA, Abel GA, Black GB, Hamilton W, King A, Mounce L, Neal RD, Nicholson BD, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Patients later diagnosed with cancer may first be diagnosed with another 'interim' diagnosis based on their clinical presentation. In some cases, interim diagnoses may be missed opportunities to diagnose cancer.
abstract.textZh: 後來被診斷出患有癌症的患者可能首先根據其臨牀表現被診斷為另一種「中期」診斷。在某些情況下，中期診斷可能會錯過診斷癌症的機會。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To explore healthcare professionals' perspectives of when interim non-cancer diagnoses occur how they have an impact on a cancer diagnosis and what could trigger their prompt review.
abstract.textZh: 探索醫療保健專業人員對臨時非癌症診斷何時發生的觀點，以及它們如何對癌症診斷產生影響，以及哪些因素可能觸發他們的即時審查。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Interviews were conducted between March and November 2024 with 35 GPs, three other clinicians, and three practice administrators from 31 general practices in southern England, UK.
abstract.textZh: 在2024年3月至11月期間，對英國英格蘭南部31家全科醫院的35名全科醫生、另外3名臨牀醫生和3名執業管理人員進行了訪談。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: The semi-structured interviews were undertaken via videocall and were analysed using framework analysis.
abstract.textZh: 半結構化訪談透過視訊通話進行，並使用架構分析進行分析。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Participants reported that interim diagnoses occurred in cases of diagnostic uncertainty, especially when non-specific symptoms were attributed to common differential diagnoses. Remote consultations were thought to increase the likelihood of interim diagnosis by limiting information gathering. Interim diagnoses were suggested to delay cancer diagnoses, although this was not always seen as avoidable. Clinicians hoped to facilitate opportunities to make a cancer diagnosis by using safety-netting to encourage reattendance, and an informal rule of 'three strikes and you're in'. Colleagues providing a 'fresh pair of eyes', discussing diagnostic uncertainty in the clinical team, and using past cases as learning opportunities were suggested approaches to facilitate prompt review of interim diagnoses.
abstract.textZh: 參與者報告說，期間診斷發生在診斷不確定的情況下，特別是當非特異性症狀歸因於常見的鑑別診斷時。遠程諮詢被認為可以通過限制信息收集來增加中期診斷的可能性。臨時診斷被建議延遲癌症診斷，儘管這並不總是被認為是可以避免的。臨牀醫生希望通過使用安全網來鼓勵重新就診，以及“三振出局”的非正式規則來促進癌症診斷的機會。同事提供「一雙新鮮的眼睛」，討論臨牀團隊中的診斷不確定性，並利用過去的病例作為學習機會，這些建議的方法有助於迅速審查中期診斷。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Consistent safety-netting is required to ensure timely review of non-cancer 'interim' diagnoses when there is a possible underlying cancer diagnosis. The range of interim diagnoses and their impact on cancer diagnosis requires further quantification to inform interventions to mitigate their effect.
abstract.textZh: 當有可能的潛在癌症診斷時，需要一致的安全網，以確保及時審查非癌症的「期中」診斷。期間診斷的範圍及其對癌症診斷的影響需要進一步量化，以為幹預措施提供信息，以減輕其影響。

articles.titleZh: “醫學中最困難的事情之一是挑戰初始診斷” ：初級護理期間診斷和錯過診斷癌症的機會，這是一項定性研究

articles.title: Reframing the manosphere: a public health response to a commercial ecosystem
articles.authors: Hawkes SJ, Buse K

abstract.text: The manosphere, a diffuse commercial ecosystem and loose collection of online communities united by shared beliefs about masculinity, misogyny, and male victimisation, is an under-recognised determinant of health harms. This network has been implicated in considerable health harms: widespread mental health impacts, especially in young people; violence against women, girls, and gender minorities; and delegitimising help-seeking in boys and men. In this Viewpoint, we argue that the manosphere is best understood and addressed as a public health problem.
abstract.textZh: Manosphere是一個分散的商業生態系統，也是由男性氣質、厭女症和男性受害的共同信念所結合的線上社區的鬆散集合，是未被認可的健康危害的決定因素。這個網絡涉及相當大的健康危害：廣泛的心理健康影響，特別是對年輕人的影響；對婦女、女孩和性別少數羣體的暴力；以及使男孩和男人尋求幫助的合法化。在這個觀點中，我們認為莊園圈最好被理解並作為一個公共衛生問題來解決。

articles.titleZh: 重新構建莊園：對商業生態系統的公共衛生反應

articles.title: Charting a course to men's health and wellbeing: applying a lens of power and politics to improve men's health outcomes
articles.authors: Hawkes SJ, Katikireddi SV, Buse K, Theobald S, Catto JWF, Smith JA, Rashid SF, Tolhurst R, et al.

abstract.text: Despite long-standing evidence of poor health and life expectancy outcomes among men, particularly among men who are socially or structurally marginalised, men's health has generally received little and uneven attention in health policy and practice. Its gendered and intersectional aspects have been especially overlooked. This third paper in the Lancet Men's Health Series examines why men's health has received so little policy attention and proposes strategies to raise men's health on national and global agendas. We applied a gender lens to the 3-i theory-based framework and analysed how ideas, interests, and institutions shape the prioritisation of men's health within national and global policy agendas. We review the modest development of men's health policies and assess how power and politics, including the roles of a range of stakeholders from global and national health spaces, commercial actors, and civil society organisations, have shaped the construction of the problem as well as policy attention and framing, resource allocation, and interventions. The scarcity of attention paid to men's health on global and national agendas reflects how power operates through ideas and institutions which contribute to the conflation of gender with women, institutional inertia, and contested constructions of individual versus structural drivers of ill health. We highlight how this has created a space in which commercial actors, including the manosphere, can shape narratives and influence men's health in ways that align with commercial or ideological interests. We conclude by proposing politically informed strategies that recognise how power, institutional arrangements, and competing interests shape men's health policy within prevailing gender and structural orders. We identify entry points for advancing men's health equity and wellbeing that draw on empirical evidence and technical guidance, are grounded in political realities, and are consistent with a commitment to gender justice for all people.
abstract.textZh: 儘管長期以來有證據表明男性，尤其是那些在社會或結構上處於邊緣地位的男性，健康狀況和預期壽命較差，但男性健康在衛生政策和實踐中普遍未得到足夠的重視，且重視程度參差不齊。其性別和交叉性因素尤其被忽略。本篇《柳葉刀男性健康系列》的第三篇文章探討了男性健康為何在政策層面如此缺乏關注，並提出了將男性健康提升至國家和全球議程的策略。我們運用性別視角，以3-i理論架構為基礎，分析了觀念、利益和製度如何影響男性健康在國家和全球政策議程中的優先地位。我們回顧了男性健康政策的緩慢發展歷程，並評估了權力與政治（包括來自全球和國家衛生領域、商業機構和民間社會組織的各類利益相關者的角色）如何影響問題的建構、政策關注和框架、資源分配以及乾預措施。全球和國家議程對男性健康關注的匱乏，反映了權力如何透過觀念和製度運作，這些觀念和製度導致性別與女性的混淆、制度惰性以及對個體健康問題與結構性健康問題之間相互矛盾的認知。我們著重指出，這如何為包括男性圈在內的商業行為者創造了塑造敘事的空間。

articles.titleZh: 制定男性健康和福祉的路線：應用權力和政治的鏡頭來改善男性的健康結果

articles.title: A global men's health epidemiology within an intersectional framework
articles.authors: Catto JWF, Thomson RM, Griffith DM, Mavhu W, Gu J, Misha F, Rashid SF, Fazel S, et al.

abstract.text: Males have lower life expectancies and greater disability-adjusted life-years (DALYs) than females, and particularly poor outcomes are seen among males in marginalised contexts. In this paper, we provide an epidemiological overview and highlight the intersectional nature of men's health. We analyse mortality and DALYs data from the 1990-2023 Global Burden of Diseases, Injuries, and Risk Factors Studies to illustrate our intersectional framework and draw attention to how health varies in men and to show key themes. Conditions that contribute most to the poor health of males include non-communicable diseases (eg, cardiovascular diseases and cancers), substance use, suicide, injuries (eg, road traffic incidents and interpersonal violence), and respiratory infections (eg, tuberculosis and COVID-19). Although cardiovascular disease and cancer make the largest contributions to men's higher mortality rates, determinants of health such as violence and war, migration, economic stagnation, and labour market changes due to automation and new technologies will disproportionally affect their health in the future. Injuries, violence, and other external morbidity causes often occur at a young age and in unequal distributions across the sexes, making a large contribution to DALYs. Although biology plays a role, the pattern of many diseases contributing to health differences reflects the intersection of health behaviours, shaped by patriarchy, ideas of masculinity, and structural drivers (including commercial determinants of health); many of these are preventable. Although improvements in some health behaviours are seen, exceptions occur in marginalising social conditions (eg, incarcerated men, men experiencing homelessness, men with mental illnesses, men with substance use disorders, men with low income, men who have sex with men, and those who are gender non-conforming). Multiple data sources detail men's shorter life expectancies and the drivers compared with women, but going beyond sex disaggregation remains challenging and is an urgent priority for research and health monitoring.
abstract.textZh: 與女性相比，男性的預期壽命和殘疾調整壽命（ DALY ）較低，邊緣化背景下的男性結果特別差。 在本文中，我們提供了流行病學概述，並強調了男性健康的交叉性。 我們分析1990-2023年全球疾病、傷害和風險因素負擔研究中的死亡率和DALY數據，以說明我們的交叉框架，並引起對男性健康如何變化的關注，並展示關鍵主題。 導致男性健康狀況不佳的疾病包括非傳染性疾病（如心血管疾病和癌症）、藥物使用、自殺、受傷（如道路交通事故和人際暴力）和呼吸道感染（如結核病和新冠肺炎）。 雖然心血管疾病和癌症對男性死亡率的貢獻最大，但暴力和戰爭、移民、經濟停滯以及自動化和新技術導致的勞動力市場變化等健康決定因素將不成比例地影響他們的健康。 傷害、暴力和其他外部發病原因通常發生在年輕時，並且在性別之間分佈不均，這對DALYs有很大貢獻。 雖然生物學發揮了作用，但導致健康差異的許多疾病的模式反映了由父權制，男性氣概和結構性驅動因素塑造的健康行為的交叉

articles.titleZh: 交叉框架下的全球男性健康流行病學

articles.title: Men's health: an intersectional and multilevel framework for understanding syndemic patterns of health
articles.authors: Tolhurst R, Egid BR, Mavhu W, Catto JWF, Fouad F, Griffith DM, Guha-Sapir D, Hawkes SJ, et al.

abstract.text: Men occupy a privileged position within gender power relations: the male body has been the default reference point for biomedical research and therapeutic development (with the historical exclusion of women from medical trials), and men dominate health services leadership and exercise well documented medical misogyny. Yet despite their privileged position, many aspects of men's health outcomes are neglected and undertheorised because they are not examined through an intersectional gender lens. Although consideration of gender and masculinity is important for understanding men's health, research thus far has focused predominantly on men's harmful health behaviours, overemphasising individual determinants of health, and a deficit-based approach. Little attention has been paid to the influence of structural determinants of men's health risks and vulnerabilities, or the gender-specific health outcomes of worsening social and economic inequalities. In this first paper of a Lancet Series on men's health, we present a conceptual framework for understanding men's health from an intersectional perspective, highlighting how structural, social, and commercial determinants of health, intersectionality, and syndemic theory can be combined to analyse men's health at different socioecological levels. We illustrate the framework using four selected case studies that show how the health outcomes of marginalised men are influenced by complex interactions. We provide a working definition of men's health that reflects existing literature and builds on the conceptual framework and case studies. Promotion of gender justice and health equity requires moving beyond one-dimensional approaches that construct men as problematic individuals, and towards better understanding and action on the broader set of power systems and structural determinants underpinning men's health.
abstract.textZh: 在性別權力關係中，男性佔據著特權地位：男性身體一直是生物醫學研究和治療發展的默認參考點（歷史上女性被排除在臨床試驗之外），男性主導著醫療服務領導層，並且存在著有據可查的醫學厭女症。然而，儘管男性擁有如此特權地位，但由於缺乏交叉性別視角，男性健康結果的許多方面卻被忽視和理論化不足。雖然考慮性別和男性氣質對於理解男性健康至關重要，但迄今為止的研究主要集中在男性有害的健康行為，過度強調個別健康決定因素，並採用缺陷觀點。很少有研究關注男性健康風險和脆弱性的結構性決定因素的影響，以及日益加劇的社會和經濟不平等所帶來的性別特異性健康後果。在本篇《柳葉刀》男性健康系列論文的第一篇中，我們提出了一個從交叉性視角理解男性健康的概念框架，重點闡述瞭如何將結構性、社會性和商業性的健康決定因素、交叉性理論和協同流行病理論結合起來，從而在不同的社會生態層面分析男性健康。我們透過四個精選的案例研究來說明該框架，這些案例研究展示了邊緣化男性的健康結果如何受到複雜交互作用的影響。我們提供了一個工作定義。

articles.titleZh: 男性健康：了解健康綜合症模式的交叉和多層次框架

articles.title: Non-invasive tests in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease: the LITMUS prospective multicentre diagnostic accuracy study
articles.authors: Vali Y, Wonders K, Lee J, Aithal GP, Aller R, Allison MED, Arola J, Banales JM, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The advent of regulatory-approved pharmacological treatments for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) calls for precise, non-invasive biomarkers that facilitate early diagnosis, support therapy selection, and aid clinical trial enrolment. The European multicentre LITMUS study aimed to evaluate the diagnostic performance of a broad range of non-invasive biomarkers for identifying patients with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), at-risk MASH, advanced fibrosis, and cirrhosis.
abstract.textZh: 新陳代謝功能障礙相關脂肪性肝病(MASLD)的藥理治療已獲得監管部門批準，需要精確、非侵入性的生物標誌物，以促進早期診斷、支持治療選擇和協助臨牀試驗入組。歐洲多中心石蕊研究旨在評估廣泛的非侵入性生物標誌物的診斷性能，以識別代謝功能障礙相關脂肪性肝炎(MASH)、高風險MASH、晚期纖維化和肝硬化的患者。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this prospective, multicentre, diagnostic accuracy study, adults with biopsy-confirmed MASLD were prospectively recruited across 13 countries in Europe and the USA. We assessed 12 single markers and 18 multimarker panels. The reference standard was centrally scored liver histology according to the non-alcoholic steatohepatitis Clinical Research Network Scoring System. Target conditions included MASH (Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease Activity Score ≥4 with ≥1 point per component), at-risk MASH (MASH plus significant fibrosis [fibrosis stage F≥2]), advanced fibrosis (F≥3), and cirrhosis (F4). Performance was evaluated by area-under-the-receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), with the minimum acceptable criterion (MAC) of AUC higher than 0·80 to indicate potential biopsy replacement.
abstract.textZh: 在這項前瞻性、多中心、診斷準確性研究中，在歐洲和美國的13個國家前瞻性地招募了活檢確診MASLD的成年人。我們評估了12個單一標記和18個多標記面板。參考標準根據非酒精性脂肪性肝炎臨牀研究網絡評分系統對肝臟組織學進行集中評分。目標條件包括MASH （非酒精性脂肪性肝病活動評分≥ 4 ，每個組分≥ 1分）、高風險MASH （ MASH加顯著纖維化[纖維化階段F ≥ 2] ）、晚期纖維化（ F ≥ 3 ）和肝硬化（ F4 ）。表現以受試者操作特性曲線(AUC)評估， AUC的最小可接受標準(MAC)高於0.80 ，以表示潛在的活組織檢查置換。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Jan 1, 2018, and June 30, 2023, we analysed data from 1590 participants with centrally scored liver biopsies and at least one biomarker measurement; 609 (38%) had biopsy-confirmed at-risk MASH, 678 (43%) had MASH, 585 (37%) had advanced fibrosis, and 164 (10%) had cirrhosis. For detecting at-risk MASH, SomaSignal showed the highest diagnostic performance (AUC 0·83 [95% CI 0·80-0·85]), significantly exceeding MAC, whereas no other test reached the MAC for MASH only. For advanced fibrosis, SomaSignal showed the highest performance (AUC 0·92 [0·90-0·94]), followed by FibroMeter-VCTE (AUC 0·87 [0·83-0·92]), Agile 3+ and TSP2 (both AUC 0·84 [0·82-0·86]), and NIS4 (0·82 [0·80-0·85]). For cirrhosis, FibroMeter-VCTE showed the highest diagnostic performance (AUC 0·94 [0·90-0·97]) followed by SomaSignal (AUC 0·92 [0·90-0·94]), followed by Agile 3+ (0·88 [0·85-0·91]), Agile 4 (0·87 [0·84-0·90]), ADAPT (0·85 [0·81-0·88]), and ELF, LSM-VCTE, and TSP2 (all 0·84 [0·81-0·87]). Sequential two-step approaches using gamma-glutamyl transferase as a first-line test met the MAC for both advanced fibrosis and at-risk MASH.

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Although single markers resulted in variable and limited performance when compared to histology for detecting at-risk MASH, multimarker panels showed great potential, with a proteomic panel showing strong diagnostic performance. These findings could support the selection and implementation of non-invasive testing strategies in MASLD and inform future clinical guidelines, regulatory evaluation, and clinical trial design.

articles.title: Prone positioning and high-frequency oscillatory ventilation in early paediatric acute respiratory distress syndrome (PROSpect): an international, two-by-two factorial, response-adaptive, phase 3, randomised controlled trial
articles.authors: Curley MAQ, Kneyber MCJ, Cheifetz IM, Kong M, Mahapatra S, Schwarz AJ, Phumeetham S, Irby K, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Data on prone positioning and high-frequency oscillatory ventilation (HFOV) used separately or in combination in patients with paediatric acute respiratory distress syndrome (PARDS) are inconclusive, leading to wide practice variability. We aimed to compare the effects of prone positioning with supine positioning and the effects of HFOV with conventional mechanical ventilation on ventilator-free days in children with early, moderate-to-severe PARDS.
abstract.textZh: 在兒科急性呼吸窘迫綜合症(PARDS)患者中單獨或聯合使用的俯臥位和高頻振盪通氣(HFOV)數據尚無定論，導致廣泛的實踐變異性。我們旨在比較俯臥位與仰臥位以及HFOV與傳統機械通氣對早期、中度至重度PARDS兒童無呼吸機日數的影響。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: PROSpect was an international, two-by-two factorial, response-adaptive, phase 3, randomised controlled trial done in 75 paediatric intensive care units in 18 countries. Eligible patients were aged 2 weeks to 20 years, and were intubated and mechanically ventilated for less than 96 h before meeting criteria for moderate-to-severe PARDS. Patients were centrally randomly assigned using a web-based system to supine positioning and conventional mechanical ventilation, prone positioning and conventional mechanical ventilation, supine positioning and HFOV, or prone positioning and HFOV. Initially, the allocation was 1:1:1:1 stratified by age group and direct or indirect lung injury using a permuted block design with blocks of four and eight. Response-adaptive randomisation updates were planned to adjust allocation probabilities 28 days after 300 patients were randomly assigned and then 28 days after every 100 additional patients. Given the nature of the interventions, masking was not possible. The primary outcome was ventilator-free days through to day 28 among all randomly assigned participants. Safety was assessed prospectively by daily monitoring for the occurrence of prespecified adverse events. This study was registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT03896763) and is closed to enrolment.
abstract.textZh: PROSpect 是一項國際性的、2×2 析因設計、響應自適應的 3 期隨機對照試驗，在 18 個國家的 75 個兒科重症監護病房 (PICU) 進行。符合條件的患者年齡為 2 週至 20 歲，在符合中重度 PARDS 標準前插管和機械通氣時間不足 96 小時。患者透過網路為基礎的系統進行中心隨機分組，分別接受仰臥位常規機械通氣、俯臥位常規機械通氣、仰臥位高頻振盪通氣 (HFOV) 或俯臥位高頻振盪通氣。初始分組採用 1:1:1:1 的比例，並按年齡組和直接或間接肺損傷進行分層，採用 4 和 8 個區組的置換區組設計。計劃在 300 名患者隨機分組後 28 天進行響應自適應隨機化更新，以調整分配機率，之後每增加 100 名患者，均在 28 天進行一次更新。鑑於幹預措施的性質，無法進行盲法。主要終點指標為所有隨機分組的受試者在第28天之前的非侵入性通氣天數。安全性評估採用前瞻性方法，每日監測預先設定的不良事件發生情形。本研究已在ClinicalTrials.gov註冊（NCT03896763），目前已停止招募。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between May 1, 2019 and Jan 13, 2026, 1045 patients were eligible for enrolment. The trial was stopped early for futility and slow enrolment after 424 of 600 planned patients were recruited. 126 patients were randomly assigned to the supine and conventional mechanical ventilation group, 130 to the prone and conventional mechanical ventilation group, 90 to the supine and HFOV group, and 78 to the prone and HFOV group. Median age was 3·3 years (IQR 1·1-10·1), 211 (50%) patients were female, and 213 (50%) were male. There were no significant differences in ventilator-free days between prone and supine positioning (median 17·9 days [IQR 8·9-21·3] vs 17·4 days [6·4-21·9]; Hodges-Lehmann location shift adjusting for ventilation 0·0 [95% CI -0·8 to 1·0]) or between HFOV and conventional mechanical ventilation (17·3 [5·7-21·6] vs 18·0 [9·9-21·5]; Hodges-Lehmann location shift adjusting for positioning -0·3 [95% CI -1·5 to 0·5]). 41 (10%) patients had died at day 28, without group differences. Plugging or obstruction of the artificial airway occurred more frequently with prone than supine positioning (14 events in 12 [6%] of 188 patients vs three events in three [2%] of 197 patients; 0·74 [95% CI 0·44-1·26] vs 0·15 [0·05-0·47] events per 100 artificial airway days; rate ratio 4·83 [95% CI 1·38-16·82]). Stage 2 or worse immobility-related pressure injuries also occurred more frequently with prone versus supine positioning (12 [6%] vs two [1%]; relative risk 6·13 [95% CI 1·45-25·97]). Haemodynamic instability occurred more frequently with HFOV than conventional mechanical ventilation (41 events in 19 [13%] of 141 patients vs 38 events in 22 [9%] of 244 patients; 2·21 [95% CI 1·63-3·00] vs 1·22 [0·89-1·68] events per 100 paediatric intensive care unit days; rate ratio 1·84 [95% CI 1·18-2·87]). One serious adverse event, an unwitnessed self-extubation followed by cardiopulmonary arrest, occurred in a patient in the prone and conventional mechanical ventilation group.

[0.05-0.47]；風險比為 4.83 [95% CI 1.38-16.82]）。與仰臥位相比，俯臥時發生 2 期或更嚴重程度的與活動受限相關的壓力性損傷的發生率也較高（12 例 [6%] 和 2 例 [1%]；相對風險比為 4.83）。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: We found no evidence to support prone positioning or HFOV as first-line strategies to improve ventilator-free days in patients with early, moderate-to-severe PARDS. Thus, the routine use of these strategies in this population is not recommended.

articles.title: Endometrial ablation plus levonorgestrel-releasing intrauterine system versus endometrial ablation alone in women with heavy menstrual bleeding in The Netherlands (MIRA2): a multicentre, open-label, randomised, controlled, superiority trial
articles.authors: Oderkerk TJ, Leemans JC, Beelen P, Herman MC, Coppus SFPJ, van der Weide MC, Van Kuijk SMJ, Clark TJ, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Endometrial ablation is an established and effective treatment for women with heavy menstrual bleeding, but many patients require further treatment, with approximately 10% ultimately undergoing a hysterectomy within 2 years. The insertion of a levonorgestrel-releasing intrauterine system (LNG-IUS) immediately after endometrial ablation might inactivate residual untreated endometrium or prevent its regeneration, thereby preventing recurrent symptoms necessitating a hysterectomy. The aim of the study was to assess whether LNG-IUS insertion immediately after endometrial ablation in women with heavy menstrual bleeding reduced the need for subsequent hysterectomy within 2 years compared with endometrial ablation alone.
abstract.textZh: 子宮內膜消融是重度月經出血婦女的既定有效治療方法，但許多患者需要進一步治療，最終約有10%的患者在2年內接受子宮切除手術。在子宮內膜消融後立即插入左炔諾孕酮釋放子宮內宮系統（ LNG-IUS ）可能會使剩餘的未經治療的子宮內膜失活或阻止其再生，從而防止需要子宮切除的復發性症狀。該研究的目的是評估重度月經出血婦女在子宮內膜切除後立即插入LNG-IUS是否比單獨的子宮內膜切除在2年內減少後續子宮切除的需要。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: This multicentre, open-label, randomised, controlled, superiority trial was conducted in 34 hospitals in the Netherlands. Women younger than 60 years with heavy menstrual bleeding who were eligible for endometrial ablation were included and randomly assigned (1:1) to combined treatment comprising endometrial ablation plus LNG-IUS or to standard care comprising endometrial ablation alone (stratified by dysmenorrhoea and age). Masking was not applied. Endometrial ablation was done using electrical radiofrequency ablation or by transcervical resection of the endometrium. In participants allocated to combined treatment, intrauterine insertion of an LNG-IUS containing a total of 52 mg of levonorgestrel (releasing 20 μg per day in the first year) was done immediately after the ablative procedure. The primary outcome was the incidence of hysterectomy within 2 years, analysed on a modified intention-to-treat basis in all participants with available data. Serious adverse events were systematically assessed at 6 weeks, 12 months, and 24 months after the intervention. This study was registered on the International Clinical Trials Registry Platform (NL-OMON54839) and is complete.
abstract.textZh: 這項多中心、開放標籤、隨機、對照、優效性試驗在荷蘭的34家醫院進行。納入了60歲以下、月經過多且符合子宮內膜消融術條件的女性，並按1:1的比例隨機分配至聯合治療組（子宮內膜消融術聯合左炔諾孕酮宮內節育系統LNG-IUS）或僅接受子宮內膜消融術的標準治療組（按痛經和年齡分層）。本研究未採用盲法。子宮內膜消融術採用射頻消融術或經子宮頸子宮內膜切除術。合併治療組的受試者在消融術後立即放置LNG-IUS，該節育系統含有52毫克左炔諾孕酮（第一年每日釋放20微克）。主要終點是2年內子宮切除術的發生率，採用改良的意向性治療分析方法，對所有有可用數據的受試者進行分析。在幹預後 6 週、12 個月和 24 個月時，對嚴重不良事件進行了系統評估。本研究已在國際臨床試驗註冊平台（NL-OMON54839）註冊，且已完成。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Nov 19, 2019, and April 5, 2023, 715 participants were randomly assigned to combined treatment (n=359) or endometrial ablation alone (n=356). The median age of all participants was 45 years (IQR 40-48). 42 (6%) participants had missing data for the primary outcome at 2 years of follow-up. A hysterectomy was done in 15 (4%) of 342 participants in the combined treatment group versus 34 (10%) of 331 participants in the endometrial ablation group, corresponding to a relative risk (RR) of 0·43 (95% CI 0·24 to 0·77; p=0·0050), with a risk difference of -0·06 (95% CI -0·10 to -0·02; p=0·0040). Serious adverse events were reported in 27 (8%) of 346 participants in the combined treatment group and 26 (8%) of 327 participants in the endometrial ablation alone group (RR 0·98, 95% CI 0·59-1·65; p=0·94), and there were no treatment-related deaths.
abstract.textZh: 在2019年11月19日至2023年4月5日期間， 715名參與者被隨機分配到聯合治療（ n = 359 ）或單獨子宮內膜消融（ n = 356 ）。所有參與者的中位年齡為45歲（ IQR 40-48 ）。42名（ 6 ％ ）參與者在隨訪2年時缺少主要結果的數據。在合併治療組的342名參與者中，有15名(4%)進行了子宮切除，而在子宮內膜消融組的331名參與者中，有34名(10%)進行了子宮切除，相應的相對風險(RR)為0 · 43 (95% CI 0 · 24至0 · 77 ； p = 0 · 0050) ，風險差異為-0 · 06 (95% CI -0 · 10至-0 · 02 ； p = 0 · 0040)。聯合治療組中346名參與者中有27名（ 8% ）報告了嚴重不良事件，單獨子宮內膜消融組中327名參與者中有26名（ 8% ）報告了嚴重不良事件（ RR 0. 98 ， 95% CI 0. 59-1. 65 ； p = 0. 94 ） ，沒有發生治療相關死亡。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: The combination of endometrial ablation and LNG-IUS significantly reduced the incidence of hysterectomy compared with endometrial ablation alone. The combined treatment appears to be a safe adjunctive strategy for heavy menstrual bleeding that does not increase the risk of complications.

articles.title: Disease-free survival and overall survival after neoadjuvant immunotherapy in mismatch repair-deficient colon cancer in the Netherlands: results of the single-arm, multicentre, phase 2, NICHE-2 trial
articles.authors: Chalabi M, van den Dungen LDW, de Gooyer PGM, Balduzzi S, Aalbers AGJ, Kerver ED, Grootscholten C, Dokter S, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Neoadjuvant immune checkpoint blockade induces high pathological response rates in patients with locally advanced mismatch repair-deficient (dMMR) colon cancer, yet long-term survival outcomes have not been established. Previously, we reported safety (a primary endpoint) and pathological response (a secondary endpoint) data from the NICHE-2 trial. Here, we report the primary efficacy endpoint of 3-year disease-free survival and the exploratory endpoint of 5-year overall survival.
abstract.textZh: 新輔助免疫檢查點阻斷在局部晚期錯配修復缺陷（ dMMR ）結腸癌患者中誘發高病理反應率，但尚未確定長期生存結果。此前，我們報告了NICHE-2試驗的安全性（主要終點）和病理反應（次要終點）數據。在這裡，我們報告了3年無病生存率的主要療效終點和5年總生存率的探索性終點。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this single-arm, multicentre, phase 2, NICHE-2 trial, patients with previously untreated, clinical stage 2 or 3, resectable dMMR colon cancer received a single dose of intravenous ipilimumab (1 mg per kg) on day 1, and two doses of intravenous nivolumab (3 mg per kg) on days 1 and 15, followed by surgery in one of the six participating hospitals in the Netherlands. Here, we report the independent primary efficacy endpoint of 3-year disease-free survival (time from surgery until disease recurrence or death from any cause) and the secondary endpoint of circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) analysis. Overall survival (time from study enrolment until death from any cause) is reported as an exploratory post-hoc analysis. All endpoints were assessed in the per-protocol population (patients who met the eligibility criteria and received at least one cycle of therapy). The study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT03026140, and has completed accrual.
abstract.textZh: 在這項單組、多中心、2期NICHE-2試驗中，先前未治療、臨牀2期或3期、可切除的dMMR結腸癌患者在第1天接受單劑量靜脈注射伊匹木單抗（每公斤1毫克） ，在第1天和第15天接受兩劑量靜脈注射納武單抗（每公斤3毫克） ，然後在荷蘭六家參與醫院之一進行手術。在這裡，我們報告了3年無病生存率（從手術到疾病復發或任何原因死亡的時間）的獨立主要療效終點和循環腫瘤DNA （ ctDNA ）分析的次要終點。總生存期（從研究入組到任何原因死亡的時間）被報告為探索性事後分析。在符合計畫書的人羣（符合資格標準且接受至少一個治療週期的患者）中評估所有終點。本研究已在ClinicalTrials.gov註冊，編號為NCT03026140 ，並已完成累計。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: From July 4, 2017, to July 18, 2022, 123 patients were screened, of whom 115 were treated and 111 were included in the per-protocol population. At the data cutoff (June 19, 2026), the postoperative median follow-up was 58·7 months (IQR 49·0-72·9). The 3-year disease-free survival was 100% (97·5% CI 100-100). After a median follow-up of 60·4 months (IQR 50·6-74·1), calculated from time of study enrolment, the 5-year overall survival was 100% (95% CI 100-100). In patients with available plasma samples, ctDNA was detected in 99 (92%) of 108 patients at baseline, and ctDNA clearance was observed in 44 (45%) of 98 patients after the first cycle in week 2 and in 80 (82%) of 97 patients after the second cycle before surgery. In patients with a pathological near-complete response and complete response, presurgery ctDNA clearance was observed in 19 (70%) of 27 patients and 60 (92%) of 65 patients, respectively. Assessment for minimal residual disease after surgery revealed that all patients were ctDNA negative.

abstract.text: In patients with locally advanced dMMR colon cancer, treatment with ipilimumab and nivolumab before surgery resulted in a 3-year disease-free survival and 5-year overall survival of 100%. These findings support neoadjuvant nivolumab plus ipilimumab as a potential standard of care for patients with locally advanced dMMR colon cancer.

articles.title: Gram-Negative Bacterial Resistance
articles.authors: Tamma PD

abstract.text: The rapid worldwide spread of antimicrobial resistance among gram-negative bacteria is driven by a complex interplay of human, environmental, and health care-associated factors and accelerated by mobile genetic elements that facilitate the dissemination of resistance genes. Resistance in gram-negative bacteria arises primarily through reduced drug entry, active drug efflux, modification of antibiotic targets, and enzymatic drug inactivation, most notably through β-lactamase production. Clinically important resistant pathogens include extended-spectrum β-lactamase-producing Enterobacterales, carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales, Pseudomonas aeruginosa with difficult-to-treat resistance, and carbapenem-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii. Limited access to effective antibiotics and the continued emergence of resistance to available agents pose substantial challenges to the management of these infections. Appropriate management requires timely and accurate diagnostics, targeted use of newer β-lactam agents, effective source control, and judicious selection of treatment durations.
abstract.textZh: 革蘭氏陰性細菌之間抗菌素耐藥性在全球範圍內的迅速傳播是由人類，環境和醫療保健相關因素的複雜相互作用驅動的，並由促進抗藥性基因傳播的移動遺傳元件加速。 革蘭氏陰性細菌的耐藥性主要通過減少藥物進入、活性藥物外流、修飾抗生素靶點和酶促藥物失活來產生，最明顯的是通過β-內酰胺酶產生。 臨牀上重要的耐藥病原體包括產生β-內酰胺酶的腸杆菌、碳青黴烯耐藥腸杆菌、具有難以治療耐藥性的綠膿假單胞菌和碳青黴烯耐藥鮑曼不動桿菌。 獲得有效抗生素的機會有限，以及對可用藥物持續出現抗藥性，對這些感染的管理構成了重大挑戰。 適當的管理需要及時和準確的診斷，有針對性地使用較新的β-內酰胺藥物，有效的來源控制和明智的治療持續時間選擇。

articles.title: Continuous Glucose Monitoring in Non-Insulin-Treated Type 2 Diabetes
articles.authors: Oser TK, Martens T, Ruedy KJ, Bergford S, Calhoun P, Chang KL, Kramer ES, Klug BA, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) has been shown to be beneficial in persons with type 1 diabetes and others with insulin-treated type 2 diabetes, but its role in the treatment of persons with type 2 diabetes not being treated with insulin has needed further study.
abstract.textZh: 持續葡萄糖監測（ CGM ）已被證明對1型糖尿病患者和其他胰島素治療的2型糖尿病患者有益，但其在治療未使用胰島素治療的2型糖尿病患者中的作用需要進一步研究。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In a 26-week trial conducted at 22 primary care practices in the United States, we randomly assigned adults with type 2 diabetes who were not using insulin to either CGM or routine care (control). The primary outcome was the glycated hemoglobin level at 26 weeks. Key CGM-measured secondary outcomes were tested hierarchically to control the type I error rate.
abstract.textZh: 在美國22個初級護理實踐中進行的為期26週的試驗中，我們隨機將未使用胰島素的2型糖尿病成年人分配到CGM或常規護理（對照）。主要結果是26週時的糖化血紅蛋白濃度。對CGM測量的關鍵次要結果進行分層測試，以控制I型錯誤率。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 145 participants were assigned to the CGM group, and 138 to the routine-care group. Participants ranged in age from 21 to 84 years. The mean (±SD) glycated hemoglobin level decreased from 8.8±1.3% at baseline to 7.2±1.1% at 26 weeks in the CGM group and from 8.7±1.2% to 8.0±1.4% in the routine-care group (adjusted mean difference, -0.9 percentage points; 95% confidence interval [CI], -1.1 to -0.6; P<0.001). The mean percentage of time that the CGM-measured glucose level was in the glucose-level range of 70 to 180 mg per deciliter was 21 percentage points higher (95% CI, 16 to 26) with CGM than with routine care (P<0.001). The between-group difference in the percentage of time that the glucose level was below 54 mg per deciliter was -0.17 percentage points (95% CI, -0.27 to -0.11; P<0.001 for noninferiority); the difference in the percentage of time that the glucose level was below 70 mg per deciliter was -0.20 percentage points (95% CI, -0.43 to -0.09; P<0.001 for noninferiority; P = 0.004 for superiority). No severe hypoglycemia events were reported.
abstract.textZh: 共有145名參與者被分配到CGM組， 138名被分配到日常護理組。 參與者的年齡範圍從21歲到84歲不等。 CGM組的平均(± SD)糖化血紅蛋白濃度從基線時的8.8 ± 1.3%降至26週時的7.2 ± 1.1% ，常規護理組從8.7 ± 1.2%降至8.0 ± 1.4% (調整平均差值， -0.9個百分點； 95%置信區間[CI] ， -1.1至-0.6 ； P < 0.001)。 CGM測量葡萄糖濃度在每分升70至180毫克葡萄糖濃度範圍內的平均時間百分比（ 95% CI ， 16至26 ）比日常護理高21個百分點（ P < 0.001 ）。 葡萄糖水平低於54毫克/分升的時間百分比組間差異為-0.17個百分點（ 95% CI ， -0.27至-0.11 ；非劣效性為P < 0.001 ） ；葡萄糖水平低於70毫克/分升的時間百分比差異為-0.20個百分點（ 95% CI ， -0.43至-0.09 ；非劣效性為P < 0.001 ；優效性為P = 0.004 ）。 未報告嚴重低血糖事件。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among adults with type 2 diabetes that was not being treated with insulin and was being managed in a primary care setting, the use of CGM led to a greater reduction in the glycated hemoglobin level and to a lower risk of hyperglycemia than routine care. (Funded by Dexcom; CONNECT ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT06601166.).
abstract.textZh: 在沒有接受胰島素治療並且在初級保健環境中進行治療的2型糖尿病成人中，使用CGM導致糖化血紅蛋白水平大幅降低，並且比常規護理更低的高血糖風險。（由Dexcom資助；連接ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT06601166。）

articles.title: Intermittent or Continuous Renal-Replacement Therapy in Acute Kidney Injury
articles.authors: Gaudry S, Boubaya M, Louis G, Chaïbi K, de Montmollin E, Bohé J, Desgrouas M, Devautour C, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The preferred method of renal-replacement therapy for acute kidney injury in critically ill patients remains uncertain.
abstract.textZh: 重症患者急性腎損傷的首選腎臟替代治療方法仍然不確定。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this multicenter, open-label, noninferiority trial, we randomly assigned critically ill adults with acute kidney injury who had indications for renal-replacement therapy to undergo intermittent hemodialysis or continuous renal-replacement therapy as the initial treatment. The primary outcome was a major adverse kidney event - defined as death, dependence on renal-replacement therapy, or a serum creatinine concentration more than 25% above the baseline value - by day 90.
abstract.textZh: 在這項多中心、開放標籤、非劣效性試驗中，我們將符合腎臟替代治療指徵的急性腎損傷危重成年患者隨機分配至間歇性血液透析組或連續性腎臟替代治療組，作為初始治療方案。主要終點為第90天發生重大腎臟不良事件，定義為死亡、依賴腎臟替代治療或血清肌酸酐濃度較基線值升高超過25%。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The trial was stopped early after sequential interim analyses showed a sustained signal of higher mortality with intermittent hemodialysis than with continuous renal-replacement therapy. A total of 554 patients underwent randomization, with 272 patients assigned to undergo intermittent hemodialysis and 282 to undergo continuous renal-replacement therapy; 535 patients (260 in the intermittent group and 275 in the continuous group) were included in the intention-to-treat population. A major adverse kidney event occurred by day 90 in 203 patients (78.1%) in the intermittent group and in 197 patients (71.6%) in the continuous group (adjusted absolute risk difference, 6.28 percentage points; 95% confidence interval [CI], -1.22 to 13.79). Death by day 90 occurred in 164 patients (63.1%) and in 147 patients (53.5%), respectively. Kaplan-Meier mortality estimates at day 90 were 63.3% and 53.6% (hazard ratio, 1.30; 95% CI, 1.04 to 1.63). The most common complication potentially related to acute kidney injury or renal-replacement therapy was hypotension, which occurred in 179 patients (68.8%) in the intermittent group and in 183 patients (66.5%) in the continuous group.
abstract.textZh: 由於連續中期分析顯示間歇性血液透析組的死亡率持續高於連續性腎臟替代療法組，因此試驗提前終止。共有554例患者被隨機分組，其中272例接受間歇性血液透析，282例接受連續性腎臟替代療法；535例患者（間歇組260例，連續組275例）被納入意向性治療分析。在第90天，間歇組有203例患者（78.1%）發生主要腎臟不良事件，連續組有197例患者（71.6%）發生主要腎臟不良事件（調整後的絕對風險差為6.28個百分點；95%置信區間[CI]為-1.22至13.79）。第90天，間歇組和連續組分別有164例患者（63.1%）死亡，連續組有147例患者（53.5%）死亡。 Kaplan-Meier法估計第90天死亡率分別為63.3%和53.6%（風險比為1.30；95%信賴區間為1.04至1.63）。與急性腎損傷或腎臟替代治療可能相關的最常見併發症是低血壓，間歇組有179例患者（68.8%）發生低血壓，持續組有183例患者（66.5%）發生低血壓。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among critically ill patients with acute kidney injury who had indications for renal-replacement therapy, intermittent hemodialysis as the initial treatment approach was not shown to be noninferior to continuous renal-replacement therapy with respect to major adverse kidney events by day 90 and was associated with higher mortality. (Funded by the French Ministry of Health; ICRAKI ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT06032884.).
abstract.textZh: 對於有腎臟替代療法適應症的急性腎臟損傷重症患者，間歇性血液透析作為初始治療方法，在第90天的重大腎臟不良事件方面並未顯示出不劣於連續性腎臟替代療法，並且與更高的死亡率相關。（由法國衛生部資助； ICRAKI ClinicalTrials.gov編號： NCT06032884 ）。

articles.title: Tozorakimab to Prevent COPD Exacerbations
articles.authors: Sciurba FC, Watz H, Bourdin A, Janssens W, Martinez FJ, Zheng J, van den Berge M, Bonini M, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Many patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) have exacerbations despite receiving standard-of-care inhaled maintenance therapy. Dysregulated interleukin-33 signaling is implicated in the pathogenesis of COPD. Tozorakimab is a monoclonal antibody that inhibits the activity of interleukin-33.
abstract.textZh: 許多慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）患者即使接受了標準的吸入維持治療，仍會出現病情加重。白血球介素-33訊息傳遞路徑失調與COPD的發病機轉有密切關係。托佐拉單抗是一種抑制白血球介素-33活性的單株抗體。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In two replicate phase 3 trials (OBERON and TITANIA), we enrolled adults with COPD who were current or former smokers and had a history of exacerbations in the previous year despite receiving stable standard-of-care inhaled maintenance therapy. There were no eligibility criteria related to blood eosinophil count. Patients were randomly assigned to receive add-on subcutaneous tozorakimab (300 mg) or placebo every 4 weeks for 52 weeks. The primary end point was the annualized rate of moderate or severe exacerbations that occurred over a 52-week period among former smokers, and the first key secondary end point was the annualized rate of moderate or severe exacerbations in the overall population. Safety was also assessed.
abstract.textZh: 在兩項REPLICATE III期試驗（ OBERON和titania ）中，我們招募了目前或以前吸煙的COPD成人，儘管接受了穩定的標準護理吸入維持治療，但在前一年仍有惡化病史。沒有與血液嗜酸性白血球計數相關的資格標準。患者被隨機分配接受附加的皮下託唑拉奇單抗（ 300毫克）或安慰劑，每4週一次，持續52週。主要終點是前吸煙者在52週期間發生的中度或重度急性發作的年化比率，而第一個關鍵次要終點是整體人羣中中度或重度急性發作的年化比率。也評估了安全性。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The overall population in OBERON included 446 patients in the tozorakimab group and 431 in the placebo group, and in TITANIA included 438 in the tozorakimab group and 435 in the placebo group. The annualized rate of moderate or severe exacerbations among former smokers was 1.34 events in the tozorakimab group and 1.90 events in the placebo group (rate ratio, 0.71; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.57 to 0.88; P = 0.002) in OBERON, and 1.37 events and 2.07 events, respectively (rate ratio, 0.66; 95% CI, 0.55 to 0.80; P<0.001), in TITANIA. In the overall population, the annualized rate of moderate or severe exacerbations was 1.41 events in the tozorakimab group and 2.00 events in the placebo group (rate ratio, 0.70; 95% CI, 0.58 to 0.85; P<0.001) in OBERON, and 1.44 events and 2.03 events, respectively (rate ratio, 0.71; 95% CI, 0.59 to 0.84; P<0.001), in TITANIA. Adverse events occurred in 70.4% of the patients in the tozorakimab group and in 77.2% of those in the placebo group in OBERON, and in 80.1% and 79.8%, respectively, in TITANIA.
abstract.textZh: OBERON 研究的總人群包括 446 例接受 tozorakimab 治療的患者和 431 例接受安慰劑治療的患者；TITANIA 研究的總人群包括 438 例接受 tozorakimab 治療的患者和 435 例接受安慰劑治療的患者。在 OBERON 研究中，既往吸菸者中度或重度急性加重的年發生率在 tozorakimab 組為 1.34 次，在安慰劑組為 1.90 次（風險比，0.71；95% 置信區間 [CI]，0.57 至 0.88；P = 0.002 置信區間 [CI]，0.57 至 0.88；P = 0.002）在 TITAN 中，兩組分別為 207.307 次。次（風險比，0.66；95% CI，0.55 至 0.80；P<0.001）。在總體人群中，OBERON 研究中，托佐拉單抗組的中度或重度病情加重年發生率為 1.41 例，安慰劑組為 2.00 例（風險比，0.70；95% CI，0.58 至 0.85；P<0.001）；TITANIA 研究中，40.57% 1.75； CI，0.59 至 0.84；P<0.001）。 OBERON 研究中，托佐拉單抗組和安慰劑組分別有 70.4% 和 77.2% 的患者發生不良事件；TITANIA 研究中，兩組分別為 80.1% 和 79.8%。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among patients with COPD, treatment with tozorakimab resulted in a significantly lower rate of moderate or severe exacerbations than placebo in the cohort of former smokers and in the overall population of current and former smokers. (Funded by AstraZeneca; OBERON ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT05166889; TITANIA ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT05158387.).
abstract.textZh: 在COPD患者中，在前吸煙者隊列以及現有和前吸煙者的整體人羣中，託唑拉奇單抗治療導致的中度或重度急性發作率顯著低於安慰劑。（由AstraZeneca資助； OBERON ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT05166889 ； TITANIA ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT05158387 ）。

articles.title: Immediate Ambulatory Electrocardiographic Monitoring in Syncope
articles.authors: Reed MJ, Goodacre S, Weir CJ, Dinsmore L, Nugent A, Kennel T, Lang CC, Grubb NR, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: In patients with syncope who present to the emergency department for evaluation, diagnosing an underlying cardiac arrhythmia remains difficult.
abstract.textZh: 在急診室進行評估的暈厥患者中，診斷潛在的心律失常仍然很困難。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted an open-label, randomized, controlled trial at 45 hospitals in the United Kingdom to assess the effects of 14-day cardiac monitoring on diagnosis, treatment, and outcomes among patients with syncope. Adults with syncope that remained unexplained after an evaluation in the emergency department were assigned in a 1:1 ratio to undergo 14-day ambulatory electrocardiographic (ECG) monitoring (the intervention group) or to receive the standard care provided for patients with unexplained syncope at each participating site (the standard-care group). The primary outcome was the mean number of patient-reported episodes of syncope at 1 year.
abstract.textZh: 我們在英國45家醫院進行了一項開放標籤、隨機、對照試驗，以評估14天心臟監測對暈厥患者的診斷、治療和結果的影響。在急診科進行評估後仍無法解釋的暈厥成人，以1: 1的比例被分配接受14天的動態心電圖(ECG)監測(幹預組) ，或接受每個參與部位為無法解釋的暈厥患者提供的標準護理(標準護理組)。主要結果是1年時患者報告的暈厥發作次數的平均值。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 2234 patients underwent randomization: 1123 were assigned to the intervention group and 1111 to the standard-care group. The mean age of the patients was 58.3 years, and 52.1% were male. After the exclusion of patients who did not complete any follow-up, a total of 1970 patients (1004 in the intervention group and 966 in the standard-care group) were included in the primary analysis. articles.title: Performance of 0/1 h versus 0/3 h pathways in patients with suspected myocardial infarction: a systematic review and individual participant data meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials
articles.authors: Boeddinghaus J, Kunz M, Lopez-Ayala P, Khand A, Inoue K, Hatherley J, Miller J, Lambrakis K, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: In patients with suspected myocardial infarction, the 0/1 h pathway (blood draws at 0 h and 1 h) is recommended in current guidelines for early risk stratification. However, individual trials used different safety outcomes, and efficacy outcomes were inconclusive or not assessed. We conducted a systematic review and individual participant data meta-analysis of all randomised controlled trials to synthesise the totality of the evidence, assess heterogeneity across trials, and evaluate clinically relevant outcomes using harmonised definitions across trials.
abstract.textZh: 在疑似心肌梗塞的患者中，建議在目前的早期風險分層指南中採用0/1小時途徑（在0小時和1小時抽血）。然而，個別試驗使用不同的安全性結果，有效性結果不具結論或未評估。我們對所有隨機對照試驗進行了系統審查和個別參與者數據薈萃分析，以合成全部證據，評估試驗之間的異質性，並使用試驗之間的統一定義來評估臨牀相關結果。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this systematic review and individual participant data meta-analysis, we searched PubMed, Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, Scopus, and the International Clinical Trials Registry Platform from inception to July 6, 2026, without language restrictions, for randomised trials comparing the safety and efficacy of 0/1 h versus 0/3 h pathways (blood draws at 0 h and 3 h, ie, standard care). Individual participant data were obtained and outcome definitions were harmonised. The primary analysis used a two-stage random-effects meta-analysis. After receipt of the individual participant data but before data harmonisation or analysis, the primary safety outcome was refined to a composite of all-cause death or new type 1 myocardial infarction within 30 days, from the originally specified composite of all-cause death or any new myocardial infarction. The primary efficacy outcomes were emergency department length of stay and direct discharge from the emergency department. This meta-analysis is registered with PROSPERO (CRD420261383452).
abstract.textZh: 在這項系統回顧和個別參與者資料薈萃分析中，我們搜尋了PubMed、Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials、Scopus和International Clinical Trials Registry Platform ，從開始到2026年7月6日，沒有語言限制，用於隨機試驗，比較0/1小時與0/3小時途徑的安全性和有效性（在0小時和3小時抽血，即標準護理）。 取得個別參與者資料，並統一結果定義。 主要療效分析使用兩階段隨機效應薈萃分析。 在收到個別參與者數據後，但在數據統一或分析之前，主要安全性結果從最初指定的全因死亡或任何新的心肌梗塞的綜合治療改進為30天內的全因死亡或新的1型心肌梗塞的綜合治療。 主要療效結果是急診部門的住院時間和直接從急診部門出院。 此薈萃分析已在PROSPERO （ CRD420261383452 ）註冊。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Our systematic review identified five randomised trials, all of which provided individual participant data. Among these, the definition of the primary safety outcome varied, and in four trials emergency department length of stay was not reported for the whole analysis population. We included 110 933 patient presentations (55 489 managed with the 0/1 h pathway and 55 444 managed with the 0/3 h pathway). Within 30 days, all-cause death or new type 1 myocardial infarction occurred in 446 patient presentations (0·8%) with the 0/1 h pathway versus 562 patient presentations (1·0%) with the 0/3 h pathway (random-effects pooled odds ratio [OR] 0·83 [95% CI 0·45-1·53]; I2=62·9%; τ2=0·143). Emergency department length of stay was 314 min (IQR 211-481) in the 0/1 h pathway group versus 308 min (209-453) in the 0/3 h pathway group (random-effects pooled geometric mean ratio 1·03 [95% CI 0·85-1·25]; I2=99·2%; τ2=0·024). Direct discharge from the emergency department occurred in 37 190 patient presentations (67·0%) with the 0/1 h pathway versus 36 485 patient presentations (65·8%) with the 0/3 h pathway (random-effects pooled OR 1·31 [95% CI 0·79-2·16]; I2=97·8%; τ2=0·156).
abstract.textZh: 我們的系統綜述確定了五項隨機試驗，所有這些試驗都提供了個別參與者的數據。 其中，主要安全性結果的定義各不相同，在四項試驗中，沒有報告整個分析人羣的急診科住院時間。 我們納入了110 933例患者介紹（ 55 489例通過0/1小時途徑進行管理， 55 444例通過0/3小時途徑進行管理）。 在30天內，全因死亡或新的1型心肌梗塞發生在446名患者中（ 0.8 ％ ） ，使用0/1小時途徑，而562名患者（ 1.0 ％ ）使用0/3小時途徑（隨機效應匯總比率[OR] 0.83 [95 ％ CI 0.45-1.53]; I2 = 62.9 ％; τ2 = 0.143 ）。 0/1小時通路組的急診科住院時間為314分鐘(IQR 211-481) ，而0/3小時通路組的住院時間為308分鐘(209-453) (隨機效應混合幾何平均值比率1 · 03 [95% CI 0 · 85-1 · 25] ； I2 = 99 · 2% ； τ2 = 0 · 024)。 0/1小時路徑的37 190名患者(67 · 0%)直接出院，而0/3小時路徑的36 485名患者(65 · 8%)直接出院(隨機效應合併或1 · 31 [95% CI 0 · 79-2 · 16] ； I2 = 97 · 8% ； τ2 = 0 · 156)。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Across the available randomised trials, short-term adverse event rates were low with both pathways, but the pooled safety estimate remained imprecise. On average, earlier cardiac troponin retesting did not reduce emergency department length of stay or clearly increase direct discharge, and substantial between-study heterogeneity indicates that treatment effects might not translate uniformly across health-care systems. For hospitals considering transitioning from a 0/3 h to a 0/1 h pathway, implementation decisions should take broader diagnostic and organisational considerations into account.
abstract.textZh: 在所有可用的隨機試驗中，兩種途徑的短期不良事件發生率都很低，但匯總的安全性估計仍然不準確。平均而言，較早的心肌肌鈣蛋白重新測試並未縮短急診科住院時間或明顯增加直接出院，研究之間的實質性異質性表明治療效果可能無法在整個醫療保健系統中均勻轉化。對於考慮從0/3小時過渡到0/1小時的醫院，實施決策應考慮更廣泛的診斷和組織考慮。

articles.title: Irritable bowel syndrome and related disorders of gut-brain interaction
articles.authors: Black CJ, Chuah KH, Nasser Y, Remes-Troche JM, Shin A, Ford AC

abstract.text: Irritable bowel syndrome, chronic constipation, and functional diarrhoea are disorders of gut-brain interaction, the symptoms of which include abnormal stool consistency or frequency accompanied by varying degrees of abdominal pain, discomfort, bloating, or distension. These conditions affect 20% of the global population with a relapsing and remitting course. Risk factors include female sex, younger age, a history of common mental disorders, and acute enteric infection. The pathophysiology of irritable bowel syndrome, chronic constipation, and functional diarrhoea remain incompletely understood, but are thought to be secondary to aberrant interactions throughout the gut-brain axis, resulting in disordered gut motility and visceral hypersensitivity. These conditions are diagnosed with a combination of clinical history, absence of alarm symptoms-such as weight loss or rectal bleeding-and targeted investigations. An empathetic management approach improves quality of life and symptoms, reduces health-care use, and enhances treatment adherence. Mainstays of treatment include education, dietary and lifestyle advice, modifying fibre intake, and drugs directed towards predominant symptoms. For severe symptoms, other treatments include specific medical devices, biofeedback, or psychological therapies. However, the effectiveness of most treatments is modest and there is an ongoing need to expand available treatments for bowel disorders, with several novel drugs currently in development.

articles.title: Left Bundle-Branch Area Pacing vs Right Ventricular Pacing for Atrioventricular Block and Preserved Left Ventricular Function: The LEAP-Block Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Li X, Wang H, Zhang W, You L, Qiu C, Jia F, Liu Z, Li X, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: For patients with atrioventricular block requiring high-burden ventricular pacing, the optimal pacing strategy to reduce heart failure (HF) and all-cause mortality remains uncertain. Robust comparative evidence on the clinical outcomes of left bundle-branch area pacing (LBBAP) vs right ventricular pacing (RVP) in this population is needed.
abstract.textZh: 對於需要高負擔心室起搏的房室傳導阻滯患者，減少心力衰竭（ HF ）和全因死亡率的最佳起搏策略仍然不確定。需要關於該人羣中左束支區域起搏（ LBBAP ）與右心室起搏（ RVP ）的臨牀結果的可靠比較證據。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To compare 24-month clinical outcomes of LBBAP vs RVP in patients with atrioventricular block and preserved left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF; ≥50%).

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: The LEAP-Block study was a prospective, multicenter, randomized, controlled, superiority trial conducted across 14 Chinese hospitals from January 2021 to August 2025, with last follow-up on June 3, 2025. Of 551 patients with LVEF 50% or greater requiring ventricular pacing who underwent eligibility assessment, 499 with anticipated ventricular pacing greater than 40% were randomized.
abstract.textZh: LEAP-Block研究是一項前瞻性、多中心、隨機、對照、優越性試驗，於2021年1月至2025年8月在14家中國醫院進行，最後追蹤日期為2025年6月3日。在接受資格評估的551名LVEF ≥ 50%且需要心室起搏的患者中， 499名預期心室起搏大於40%的患者被隨機分配。

abstract.label: INTERVENTIONS
abstract.text: Patients were randomized in a 1:1 ratio to LBBAP (n = 249) or RVP (n = 250).
abstract.textZh: 患者以1: 1的比例隨機分配至LBBAP (n = 249)或RVP (n = 250)。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: The primary end point was a composite of all-cause death, HF events, or upgrade to biventricular pacing at 24 months. Secondary end points included pacing-induced cardiomyopathy and device-related complications.
abstract.textZh: 主要終點是24個月時全因死亡、心力衰竭事件或升級為雙心室心律調節的綜合結果。次要終點包括心律調節引起的心肌病和器械相關的併發症。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The primary analysis included 482 patients (LBBAP, n = 242; RVP, n = 240; mean age, 67 years; 46% female). Acute procedure success was comparable between the 2 groups (LBBAP, 237/242 [97.9%] vs RVP, 239/240 [99.6%]; P = .22), with left bundle-branch capture confirmed in 188 of 236 patients (79.7%). LBBAP significantly reduced the primary end point vs RVP (2.4% vs 12.5%, respectively; absolute risk difference, -10.1% [95% CI, -16.8% to -3.4%]; P = .003). Among secondary outcomes, the LBBAP group had fewer HF events (3.4% vs 11.3%; -7.9% [95% CI, -13.0% to -2.8%]). No significant differences were observed in all-cause death, biventricular pacing upgrade, device-related complications, or pacing-induced cardiomyopathy. The 24-month Kaplan-Meier estimated cumulative incidence of the primary end point was 5.0% for LBBAP vs 13.2% for RVP (hazard ratio, 0.37 [95% CI, 0.19 to 0.73]; P = .004). LBBAP superiority was consistent across all prespecified subgroups.
