articles.title: In Vitro Fertilization or Intrauterine Insemination in Unexplained Infertility
articles.authors: Prentice LR, Sadler LC, Anderson KL, Wilkinson JD, Vercoe MA, Lensen SF, Glanville EJ, Wakeman SA, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Although international guidelines recommend intrauterine insemination (IUI) with ovarian stimulation as first-line treatment for unexplained infertility, evidence from comparisons of this method with in vitro fertilization (IVF) is limited.

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted a sequential, multicenter, randomized, controlled trial involving couples with unexplained infertility. Stage 1 was a noninferiority comparison between IUI with ovarian stimulation (up to four cycles) and IVF (one complete cycle, with transfer of all embryos). After 7 months, couples without live birth or ongoing pregnancy could proceed to stage 2: couples in the IUI group could undergo up to two IVF cycles, and those in the IVF group could undergo one further IVF cycle. The primary outcome was the cumulative live-birth rate resulting from stage 1. Couples who were in stage 1 during lockdowns due to coronavirus disease 2019 were omitted from the analysis of the primary outcome. A secondary outcome was the cumulative live-birth rate resulting from stages 1 and 2. Live births were included in analyses if day 1 of the treatment cycle that led to pregnancy or day 1 of the last menstrual period before conception occurred within 7 months (stage 1) or 20 months (stage 2) after randomization. The noninferiority margin for the primary outcome was a between-group difference of 10 percentage points.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 737 couples underwent randomization: 365 couples were assigned to undergo IUI with ovarian stimulation before IVF, and 372 were assigned to undergo first-line IVF (1 couple in the IVF group withdrew consent for the use of data). The primary-outcome analysis included 585 couples (288 in the IUI group and 297 in the IVF group). The cumulative live-birth rate from stage 1 was 31% (89 births among 288 couples) with IUI with ovarian stimulation and 55% (164 births among 297 couples) with IVF (adjusted risk difference, -24 percentage points; 95% confidence interval [CI], -31 to -16). The cumulative live-birth rate from stages 1 and 2 among all the couples who had undergone randomization and provided consent was 70% (257 births among 365 couples) and 71% (265 births among 371 couples), respectively (adjusted risk difference, 0 percentage points; 99% CI, -9 to 8). Overall, serious adverse events occurred in 6 couples in the IUI group and in 14 couples in the IVF group; most serious adverse events were related to oocyte retrieval or hyperstimulation.

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: In couples with unexplained infertility, treatment with four cycles of IUI with ovarian stimulation was not noninferior to treatment with one complete cycle of IVF with respect to the cumulative live-birth rate. (Funded by the Health Research Council of New Zealand and others; FIIX Australian New Zealand Clinical Trials Registry number, ACTRN12619001003167.).

articles.title: Laparoscopic Versus Open Liver Resection for Colorectal Liver Metastases : An Individual Participant Data Meta-analysis of Four Randomized Clinical Trials
articles.authors: Olij B, Pilz da Cunha G, Pugh SA, Abu Hilal M, Lopez-Lopez V, Aghayan D, Brusadin R, Fichtinger RS, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Randomized clinical trials (RCTs) have compared laparoscopic liver resection (LLR) and open liver resection (OLR) for colorectal liver metastases (CRLM); however, long-term outcomes and subgroup effects have not been comprehensively evaluated.

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: To compare postoperative and long-term oncologic outcomes after LLR versus OLR for CRLM using individual participant data from RCTs.

abstract.label: DATA SOURCES
abstract.text: PubMed, Embase, and Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials were searched from database inception through March 2025 for RCTs comparing LLR and OLR for CRLM.

abstract.label: STUDY SELECTION
abstract.text: Eligible studies were RCTs comparing LLR and OLR for CRLM.

abstract.label: DATA EXTRACTION
abstract.text: Individual participant data, including unpublished data, were obtained from trial investigators of all 4 published RCTs.

abstract.label: DATA SYNTHESIS
abstract.text: Analyses used a modified intention-to-treat approach and 1-stage individual participant data meta-analysis (IPDMA) with trial-adjusted regression models and g-computation to estimate standardized treatment effects across outcomes, with 95% CIs obtained by nonparametric bootstrap resampling. Prespecified subgroup analyses assessed heterogeneity of treatment effect for the primary outcome. A total of 761 patients were included (laparoscopic, n = 384; open, n = 377). Postoperative morbidity was lower in patients assigned to laparoscopic surgery compared with open surgery (19% vs. 27%). Among patients who received preoperative systemic therapy, morbidity did not differ between groups (25% vs. 24%). Ninety-day mortality was 1.8% after LLR and 0.8% after OLR. After a median follow-up of 93 months, overall survival and disease-free survival did not differ between groups.

abstract.label: LIMITATION
abstract.text: Analyses were limited to variables available across all studies.

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: In this IPDMA of all published RCTs in the field, LLR for CRLM was associated with lower postoperative morbidity than OLR, with similar long-term oncologic outcomes.

abstract.text: None. (PROSPERO: CRD42024502655).

articles.authors: Yun JS, Mun H, Jung JH, Park Y, Kim SY, Kim K, Ko SH, Ahn YB, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Obesity and early-onset cancer are both increasing among young adults, yet evidence remains limited.

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To assess associations between obesity and early-onset cancer risk in young adults.

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Nationwide population-based cohort study.

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Korean National Health Insurance Service database, 2009 to 2021.

abstract.label: PATIENTS
abstract.text: 6 313 338 adults aged 20 to 39 years without prior cancer, from a national health screening program.

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Body mass index (BMI) was categorized into 5 groups (underweight to class II obesity) according to Asian-specific criteria. The outcome was incident cancer.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: During a mean follow-up of 11.2 years, 151 893 cancer cases occurred. Ten-year cumulative incidence ranged from 1.84% (95% CI, 1.83% to 1.86%) in the normal-weight group to 2.24% (CI, 2.22% to 2.27%) in class I obesity and 2.62% (CI, 2.56% to 2.68%) in class II obesity, with absolute risk differences of 0.40% (CI, 0.39% to 0.41%) and 0.78% (CI, 0.73% to 0.82%). The relative association was more pronounced in men, and absolute risk differences were greater in women. In combined BMI-waist circumference analyses, people with class I obesity based on BMI and with abdominal obesity had higher 10-year cumulative incidence (2.45% [CI, 2.41% to 2.50%]) than those without abdominal obesity (2.13% [CI, 2.10% to 2.16%]), exceeding that of those with class II obesity without abdominal obesity (2.20% [CI, 2.03% to 2.36%]). The highest cumulative incidence was observed for thyroid, endometrial, and ovarian cancer. Obesity was not associated with higher risk for breast cancer diagnosed by age 50 years.

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Obesity in young Korean adults, measured by BMI and waist circumference, is associated with higher early-onset cancer risk persisting into midlife, with patterns varying by cancer type. Early weight management may be important for prevention.

articles.title: Identification of anxiety and depression in community-dwelling people with dementia: a multiperspective qualitative study
articles.authors: Nimmons D, Aboughdir M, Walters K, Cooper C, Renukanthan A, Chew-Graham CA, Kingstone T, Bazo-Alvarez JC, et al.

abstract.text: Background Symptoms of anxiety and depression are common in people with dementia but can be challenging to distinguish from other symptoms, leading to misrecognition. Aim To explore the perspectives of people with dementia, their carers and health and social care professionals (HSCPs) regarding how anxiety and depressive symptoms in community-dwelling people with dementia, are identified and conceptualised. Design and Setting Qualitative study with people with dementia and anxiety/depression, their carers and primary care HSCPs in England. Method Semi-structured and group interviews were conducted with 56 participants face-to-face, via phone/video call. Interviews were audio-recorded, transcribed and data analysed using reflexive thematic analysis. Results Two themes and six subthemes were developed. The first theme, 'Factors informing identification and diagnosis' described the challenges of distinguishing symptoms of anxiety, depression or dementia. All participant groups felt similarity of anxiety and depressive symptoms with cognitive impairment can delay dementia diagnosis. HSCPs and carers felt that as dementia progressed, observed changes in behaviour and emotional responses over time could aid recognition. Anxiety and depression were often attributed to dementia by HSCPs and carers, but other comorbidities can contribute, and other causes should be explored. All groups felt contextual factors such as personality could influence presentation of anxiety and depression. The second theme was 'stigma of help-seeking'. All groups felt help-seeking was affected by cultural influences e.g., ethnicity, denial and masking of symptoms. Conclusion, Identification of anxiety and depression in dementia is complex. Consideration of factors such as changing behaviours, co-morbidities, culture and stigma may aid recognition.

articles.title: Sacituzumab Tirumotecan plus Pembrolizumab in PD-L1-Negative Advanced NSCLC
articles.authors: Zhou F, Meng X, Ding Q, Zhang P, Liang W, Guo S, Yu Y, Yao W, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy with a platinum-based agent and pemetrexed is a widely used standard first-line treatment option for patients with programmed death ligand 1 (PD-L1)-negative advanced nonsquamous non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) without targetable genomic alterations, but outcomes remain suboptimal.

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this phase 3, open-label, randomized trial, we evaluated sacituzumab tirumotecan plus pembrolizumab in patients with previously untreated locally advanced or metastatic nonsquamous NSCLC without targetable genomic alterations and a PD-L1 tumor proportion score of less than 1%. Patients were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive sacituzumab tirumotecan plus pembrolizumab or chemotherapy plus pembrolizumab. The primary end point was progression-free survival as assessed by blinded independent central review. Overall survival was a secondary end point. This report presents the results of the prespecified interim analysis.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 455 patients were randomly assigned to receive sacituzumab tirumotecan plus pembrolizumab (229 patients) or chemotherapy plus pembrolizumab (226 patients). After a median follow-up of 9.7 months, the median progression-free survival was significantly longer with sacituzumab tirumotecan plus pembrolizumab than with chemotherapy plus pembrolizumab (15.0 months vs. 5.7 months; hazard ratio for disease progression or death, 0.49; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.36 to 0.65; P<0.001). An objective response occurred in 50.2% and 47.3% of the patients, respectively, and the median duration of response was 13.6 months and 6.8 months. Overall survival data were immature; the hazard ratio for death was 0.58 (95% CI, 0.38 to 0.88). Adverse events of grade 3 or higher that occurred after the start of treatment were reported in 47.6% of the patients assigned to receive sacituzumab tirumotecan plus pembrolizumab and in 60.6% of those assigned to receive chemotherapy plus pembrolizumab. Stomatitis was common with sacituzumab tirumotecan plus pembrolizumab, but the events were predominantly grade 1 or 2.

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among patients with PD-L1-negative advanced nonsquamous NSCLC without targetable genomic alterations, first-line treatment with sacituzumab tirumotecan plus pembrolizumab led to significantly longer progression-free survival than chemotherapy plus pembrolizumab. (Funded by Sichuan Kelun-Biotech Biopharmaceutical; OptiTROP-Lung06 ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT06711900.).

articles.title: Osimertinib-Savolitinib in Advanced NSCLC after Progression during EGFR-TKI Therapy
articles.authors: Lu S, Girard N, Yang JC, Shepherd FA, Dong X, Arulananda S, Metro G, Hayashi H, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Savolitinib is an oral, potent, highly selective MET-tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI). Combination therapy with savolitinib and osimertinib, an epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)-TKI, has shown activity in patients with EGFR-mutated, advanced non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) with MET overexpression, MET amplification, or both, after progression during EGFR-TKI therapy.

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this international, phase 3, open-label trial, we randomly assigned, in a 1:1 ratio, patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with MET overexpression (staining intensity of 3+ for MET in ≥90% of tumor cells on immunohistochemical analysis), MET amplification (≥10 gene copies on fluorescence in situ hybridization), or both whose disease had progressed during osimertinib therapy to receive osimertinib (at a dose of 80 mg once daily) plus savolitinib (300 mg twice daily) or intravenous platinum-pemetrexed. The primary end point was progression-free survival, as assessed by blinded independent central review. Secondary end points included overall survival and safety.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Of the 1746 patients screened, 338 were randomly assigned to receive osimertinib-savolitinib (171 patients) or platinum-pemetrexed (167 patients). Osimertinib-savolitinib led to significantly longer progression-free survival than platinum-pemetrexed (hazard ratio for disease progression or death, 0.55; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.42 to 0.72; P<0.001), as well as significantly longer overall survival (hazard ratio for death, 0.68; 95% CI, 0.50 to 0.91; P = 0.01; final analysis). The Kaplan-Meier estimate of 12-month progression-free survival was 36% in the osimertinib-savolitinib group and 10% in the platinum-pemetrexed group, and the estimate of 12-month overall survival was 70% and 53%, respectively. The most frequently reported adverse events that occurred during treatment in the osimertinib-savolitinib group were peripheral edema (in 49% of the patients), anemia (in 26%), and diarrhea (in 26%). Grade 3 or higher adverse events during treatment were reported in 64% of the patients in the osimertinib-savolitinib group and in 63% of those in the platinum-pemetrexed group.

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Osimertinib-savolitinib led to significantly longer progression-free and overall survival than platinum-pemetrexed among patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with MET overexpression, MET amplification, or both that had progressed during osimertinib therapy (Funded by AstraZeneca; SAFFRON ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT05261399.).

articles.title: Overuse and False Restraint in Large Language Model Recommendations for Choosing Wisely Scenarios
articles.authors: Ariel D, Endelman S, Laban G

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The Choosing Wisely initiative made recommendations where screening, testing, or treatment may be overused, with caveats around appropriate use. Clinicians are increasingly using large language models (LLMs).
abstract.textZh: 「明智選擇」計劃提出了可能過度使用篩選、測試或治療的建議，並對適當使用提出了警告。臨牀醫生越來越多地使用大型語言模型（ LLM ）。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To evaluate whether commercial LLMs appropriately call for restraint or action from scenarios based on Choosing Wisely recommendations.
abstract.textZh: 根據明智選擇的建議，評估商業LLM是否適當地要求情境中的克制或行動。

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Benchmark evaluation. Fifteen Choosing Wisely recommendations were used to develop 225 scenarios (per recommendation, 10 in which restraint was appropriate and 5 in which action was appropriate). Six commercial LLMs (3 runs each) generated 4050 responses to the 225 scenarios, using a prompt from the clinician perspective.
abstract.textZh: 基準評估。使用15個明智選擇建議來制定225個情境（根據建議，其中10個是適當的限制， 5個是適當的行動）。六個商業LLM （每個運行3次）使用臨牀醫生的提示對225個情境產生了4050個回應。

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Production application programming interfaces of OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google from February to March 2026.
abstract.textZh: 2026年2月至3月， OpenAI、Anthropic和Google的生產應用程式設計介面。

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: No human participants were involved.
abstract.textZh: 沒有人類參與。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Co-primary outcomes were the overuse rate (endorsing action when restraint was appropriate) and the false restraint rate (withholding an appropriate action).
abstract.textZh: 共同主要結果是過度使用率（在適當時批準採取行動）和錯誤限制率（不採取適當行動）。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The rate of LLM-recommended overuse was 5.4% (95% CI, 0.6% to 12.2%); LLMs did not recommend overuse in 8 of 15 recommendations. Two recommendations accounted for most LLM-recommended overuse: thyroid ultrasound for an incidental subcentimeter nodule (overuse recommended in 42.8% of LLM responses) and routine electrocardiography in low-risk adults (overuse recommended in 28.3% of LLM responses). The LLMs recommended overuse in 0.6% to 3.3% of responses for the remaining 5 recommendations. False restraint was rare (0.6% [CI, 0.1% to 1.2%]), was absent for 11 of 15 recommendations, and was highest for prostate-specific antigen screening (3.3%).
abstract.textZh: LLM建議過度使用率為5.4% （ 95% CI ， 0.6%至12.2% ） ； 15項建議中有8項LLM不建議過度使用。兩項建議解釋了大多數LLM建議過度使用的原因：針對附帶的次公分結節進行甲狀腺超聲檢查（ 42.8%的LLM回應中建議過度使用） ，以及針對低風險成人進行常規心電圖檢查（ 28.3%的LLM回應中建議過度使用）。LLM建議過度使用，其餘5項建議的回應為0.6%至3.3%。錯誤限制很少見（ 0.6% [CI ， 0.1%至1.2%] ） ， 15項建議中有11項不存在，前列腺特異性抗原篩選最高（ 3.3% ）。

abstract.label: LIMITATIONS

articles.authors: Oseran AS, Liu-Hass M, Shanab BM, Zheng Z, Lalani C, Yeh RW, Wadhera RK

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Medicare Advantage insurers conduct in-home health risk assessments (HRAs) to identify high-risk patients and facilitate appropriate care. Critics argue this practice increases risk-adjusted payments without improving quality. Comprehensive data on use of in-home HRAs and downstream treatment are lacking.

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Cohort study.
abstract.textZh: 世代研究。）

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Population-based.
abstract.textZh: 以人羣為基礎。

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS

abstract.textZh: Medicare Advantage受益人。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Using 100% Medicare claims, trends in the proportion of cardiovascular conditions diagnosed during in-home HRAs (vs. facility-based visits) were examined. abstract.text: The United States recently proposed changes to the recommendations for childhood hepatitis B virus (HBV) vaccination.

articles.authors: Fung K, Sujan AC, Bateman BT, Straub L, Hernandez-Diaz S, Brill G, Zhu Y, Cohen LS, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Existing data on malformations associated with benzodiazepine use in pregnancy are conflicting.
abstract.textZh: 與懷孕期間使用苯二氮卓類藥物相關的畸形現有數據相互矛盾。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To assess the risk for major congenital malformations from first-trimester exposure to benzodiazepines.
abstract.textZh: 評估因暴露於苯二氮卓類藥物而導致的主要先天性畸形的風險。

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Population-based U.S. cohort study.
abstract.textZh: 以人羣為基礎的美國隊列研究。

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Medicaid (2000-2018) and Merative MarketScan (2003-2020) databases.
abstract.textZh: Medicaid （ 2000-2018 ）和Merative MarketScan （ 2003-2020 ）資料庫。

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Pregnant persons enrolled from 90 days before pregnancy to 30 days after delivery, and their live-born infants enrolled for 90 days after birth.
abstract.textZh: 孕婦於懷孕前90天至分娩後30天入組，其活產嬰兒於分娩後90天入組。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Exposure was defined as at least 1 fill of a benzodiazepine in the first trimester. Primary outcomes were any major congenital malformation and organ-specific malformations previously associated with benzodiazepine exposure. The investigators estimated relative risks (RRs) comparing exposed versus unexposed pregnancies with propensity score fine stratification weights to control for confounders. An RR of 1.3 or higher was prespecified as clinically significant.
abstract.textZh: 暴露定義為在妊娠早期至少注射1次苯二氮卓類藥物。主要結果是先前與苯二氮卓類藥物接觸有關的任何重大先天性畸形和器官特異性畸形。研究者估計相對風險(RR) ，將暴露與未暴露的懷孕進行比較，其中傾向評分為精細分層權重，以控制混雜因素。預先指定RR為1.3或更高，具有臨牀顯著性。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: In total, 51 339 of 2 478 434 (2.1%) publicly insured and 27 779 of 1 750 721 (1.6%) commercially insured pregnancies had benzodiazepine exposure. The adjusted absolute risks for any malformation in exposed versus unexposed pregnancies were 4.0% versus 4.1% for Medicaid and 4.9% versus 4.8% for MarketScan. The pooled adjusted RR was 0.99 (95% CI, 0.96 to 1.03). Associations with organ-specific malformations were not consistently observed in sensitivity analyses, nor was a dose-response relationship observed. Analyses of different benzodiazepines yielded similar results. The risk for selected organ-specific malformations was increased in some analyses of coexposure to benzodiazepines and other psychoactive medications, but a consistent pattern did not emerge.
abstract.textZh: 總體而言， 2 478 434人中有51 339人（ 2.1 ％ ）投保公共保險， 1 750 721人中有27 779人（ 1.6 ％ ）投保商業保險的懷孕有苯二氮卓類藥物暴露。暴露與未暴露妊娠中任何畸形的調整絕對風險為4.0 ％ ，而醫療補助為4.1 ％ ， MarketScan為4.9 ％和4.8 ％。匯集的調整後RR為0.99 （ 95% CI ， 0.96至1.03 ）。敏感性分析中未持續觀察到與器官特異性畸形的關聯，也未觀察到劑量反應關係。不同苯二氮卓類藥物的分析得到了類似的結果。在一些共暴露於苯二氮卓類藥物和其他精神作用藥物的分析中，特定器官特異性畸形的風險增加，但沒有出現一致的模式。

abstract.label: LIMITATIONS
abstract.text: Potential nondifferential exposure and outcome misclassification; analyses restricted to malformations prevalent at birth.
abstract.textZh: 潛在的非差異暴露和結果錯誤分類；分析僅限於出生時普遍存在的畸形。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: No substantial increase in the risk for malformations was consistently identified across data sources. Findings from coexposure analyses were inconsistent and warrant further study.
abstract.textZh: 各種資料來源均未發現畸形風險的顯著增加。共同暴露分析的結果不一致，需要進一步研究。

abstract.label: PRIMARY FUNDING SOURCE
abstract.text: National Institute of Child Health and Human Development.
abstract.textZh: 國家兒童健康與人類發展研究所。

articles.titleZh: 苯二氮卓類藥物在懷孕早期使用和先天性畸形風險
